q: An 85-year-old man admitted to the Intensive Care Unit following a massive stroke suddenly developed new weakness. Physical examination confirmed papilledema (see report). Emergency CT brain: Hemorrhagic transformation. Which of the following is the most definitive treatment?
r: Mannitol جسر مؤقت. العلاج النهائي لـmass effect ← Decompressive craniotomy.

q: A 26-year-old man is evaluated in the Emergency Department 1 hour after having a firsttime generalized tonic-clonic seizure. He has never had a seizure previously or any episode of jerking, staring, confusion, or memory loss. He has had no recent illness and has no history of neurological problems. Birth and development were normal. There is no family history of seizures or epilepsy. He takes no medication and does not use illicit drugs. His vital signs are normal. Neurological findings are unremarkable. Results of laboratory studies show a normal complete blood count and metabolic panel. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial step in management?
r: لو focal deficit/fever/head trauma ← CT/LP مباشرة. بعد CT ← EEG وMRI.
kw: normal complete blood count and metabolic panel

q: A 24-year-old woman is seen in the preconception clinic. She was diagnosed with generalized tonic-clonic epilepsy 2 years ago. She is poorly controlled. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
r: Preconception + epilepsy غير مضبوط ← Review medication (valproate لازم يتغير) وfolic acid ٥ mg.

q: A 44-year-old woman is seen in the clinic with difficult-to-control asthma despite being on high-dose inhaled steroids and frequent courses of systemic steroids. She also has a history of allergic rhinitis and nasal polyps. She claims to use aspirin and ibuprofen for migraine almost daily. She is a non-smoker and works in a school. Examination reveals nasal polyps and bilateral expiratory wheezing on chest auscultation (see report). Chest X-ray: Normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Direct laryngoscopy to assess upper airways
Blood eosinophil count and serum IgE level
Discontinue aspirin and ibuprofen and start Montelukast
r: لو ما فيه NSAID/polyps ← افحصي eosinophils وIgE (allergic/ABPA).

q: A 33-year-old woman, who is known to have bronchial asthma and chronic sinusitis, is complaining of worsening shortness of breath and a cough that disturbs her sleep. She denied any fever, headache, or chest pain. Her medications include salbutamol MDI prn and paracetamol. Chest examination reveals bilateral expiratory wheezes. Which of the following should be added to the management plan?
r: لو الأعراض نادرة ← SABA بس. لو severe exacerbation ← Oral prednisone.

q: A 20-year-old woman is brought to the Emergency Room with a 2-day history of headache, fever, photosensitivity, lethargy, and skin eruption. Her examination reveals a drowsy woman with neck rigidity but no focal neurological findings. She has a purpuric skin rash over her extremities (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation to establish the diagnosis?
r: Meningococcemia ← ابدئي ceftriaxone فورًا ولا تأخرين العلاج لأجل LP.

q: A 70-year-old man complains that he cannot remember things, sometimes forgetting names of friends, famous community figures, and telephone numbers. His wife fears he has Alzheimer’s disease. Physical examination is unremarkable apart from tender knee joints (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Dementia ← يضعف وظائف الحياة اليومية ويتدهور. Benign forgetfulness ← يتذكر لاحقًا بدون تأثير.
kw: wife fears he has Alzheimer’s disease

q: A 69-year-old man complains of shortness of breath and weight loss for the last 6 months. He has a 40-pack-year smoking history and no TB or HIV risk factors (see reports). Chest X-ray: A large left-sided pleural effusion. Thoracentesis: 1,500 mL of bloody fluid that is strongly exudative by Light's criteria. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: لو fever + pus ← antibiotics + drainage (empyema). لو cytology سلبي والشك عالي ← Thoracoscopy.
kw: weight loss for the last 6 months

q: A young man with HIV was admitted to the Intensive Care Unit with progressive shortness of breath, cough, and fever. Examination showed he was dyspneic and cyanosed (see report). Chest X-ray: Signs of ARDS. Which of the following is the most likely causative organism?
r: PJP: CD4 أقل من ٢٠٠ + LDH عالي + ground-glass. لو CD4 عالي ← typical bacteria (S. pneumoniae).
kw: progressive shortness of breath, cough, and fever

q: A 22-year-old man is evaluated for a 2-day history of dysuria and urethral discharge. He had recent sexual activity with a new female partner. He is afebrile, and his examination is unremarkable (see report). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
r: لو gonorrhea مؤكد ← Ceftriaxone. المفتاح هنا يغطي chlamydia ← Azithromycin.

q: A young man who is sexually active is evaluated in the clinic for clinical features that suggest gonorrhea. Which of the following tests is the most appropriate to establish the diagnosis?
r: لو امرأة ← cervical swab/NAAT. Disseminated ← blood/joint culture.
kw: most appropriate to establish the diagnosis

q: A 22-year-old prisoner presented with fever, productive cough, and weight loss for 3 weeks. He was admitted to isolation as a case of open tuberculosis (TB), and the next day, he was discovered to be HIV positive. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Start both HIV and TB therapy
Start HIV therapy first until CD4 count improves
Start anti-TB therapy alone to prevent immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome
r: المفتاح: ابدئي anti-TB أول (تجنب IRIS). لو CD4 أقل من ٥٠ ← ابدئي ART خلال أسبوعين.

q: A 32-year-old man with HIV presents to the clinic for follow-up. He is generally doing well. However, Mantoux tuberculin test (PPD) after 48 hours is 6 mm. His chest radiography (CXR) is unremarkable. Which of the following is the best preventative measure for this patient?
o: Isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol for 9 months
r: HIV + PPD ≥ 5 مم ← Latent TB ← INH + pyridoxine ٩ شهور. أقل من ٥ ← لا.
kw: Mantoux tuberculin test (PPD) after 48 hours is 6 mm

q: A 61-year-old woman is evaluated for a left pulmonary nodule that was discovered incidentally 2 months ago. She is currently asymptomatic and has not had shortness of breath, fever, chills, weight loss, or night sweats. Medical history is otherwise unremarkable, and she takes no medications. She never smoked. Examination revealed no cervical or supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, and the lungs are clear to auscultation (see report). CT scan chest: Showed an 8 mm left lung nodule. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: لو smoker أو الـnodule أكبر/high risk ← PET/CT. لو كبر بالمتابعة ← biopsy/resection.

q: A 30-year-old man presents with cough, fever, and right-sided pleuritic chest pain for 2 days. He is a non-smoker and works as a school teacher. He has no significant past medical history and does not take any medicine. Examination reveals bronchial breath sounds at the right lower chest (see report). Chest X-ray: Right lower lobe pneumonia and 25 mm pleural effusion on decubitus film. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in the management?
r: لو effusion صغير جدًا (أقل من ١ سم) ← antibiotics بس.
kw: 25 mm pleural effusion on decubitus film

q: A 32-year-old housemaid was brought to the Emergency Room with headache, confusion, and fever for 2 weeks. She just came from India 1 month ago. Examination reveals a confused patient with neck rigidity. Fundus examination shows papilledema (see lab results and report). Brain CT scan: No masses or hemorrhage. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Admit the patient to a negative pressure isolation room
Send CSF fluid for TB culture and wait for the results
Start isoniazid (INH), rifampin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol
r: شك TB meningitis ← ابدئي anti-TB (مع steroids) ولا تنتظرين culture.
kw: just came from India 1 month ago
headache, confusion, and fever for 2 weeks

q: A 44-year-old Saudi man is evaluated because of a 3-month history of fever and back pain that radiates to his legs. His examination reveals bony tenderness over the entire back. Blood culture shows gram-negative coccobacilli. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: لو acid-fast bacilli ← TB spine (Pott). لو ملامسة ماشية/حليب خام ← Brucellosis.
kw: 3-month history of fever and back pain
bony tenderness over the entire back

q: A 50-year-old man known to have chronic viral hepatitis presented with ascites and was found to have a high serum ascites albumin gradient (SAAG) of more than 1.1. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
r: SAAG أكثر من ١٫١ ← portal hypertension (cirrhosis). أقل من ١٫١ ← TB/nephrotic/pancreatitis.
kw: serum ascites albumin gradient (SAAG) of more than 1.1

q: A 35-year-old Indian man presents to the Emergency Department with lethargy, weight loss, and headache for 3 months. He has a history of contact with a tuberculosis patient several years ago. His neurological and ophthalmologic examination are unremarkable. He has a positive polymerase chain reaction for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
o: Isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol and diuretics
Isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol and acyclovir
Isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol and dexamethasone
r: TB meningitis ← anti-TB + dexamethasone. لو TB رئوي بدون CNS ← anti-TB بدون steroids.
kw: positive polymerase chain reaction for Mycobacterium tuberculosis
contact with a tuberculosis patient several years ago

q: A 29-year-old nurse is evaluated in the clinic for employment contract renewal. She is asymptomatic, and her clinical examination is unremarkable. Her laboratory tests are within normal range. Her skin purified protein derivative (PPD) test after 48 hours is 12 mm. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Isoniazid, rifampin, and ethambutol for 6 months
r: لو أقل من ١٠ مم (healthcare) ← لا علاج. لو HIV ← ٥ مم كافية. latent TB ← INH ٦–٩ شهور.

q: A 35-year-old man presents to the clinic with a 4-month history of fever, night sweats, fatigue, arthralgia, and lower back pain. He had a history of unpasteurized milk ingestion. His examination reveals right knee arthritis and limited spinal movements. His cardiopulmonary examination is unremarkable (see lab results and reports). Right knee joint aspiration: WBC 15,000 (0-200). Blood culture: Negative. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
r: لو Gram-positive cocci بالـaspirate ← Septic arthritis. حليب غير مبستر + sacroiliitis ← Brucella serology.

q: A patient with highly suspicious pulmonary tuberculosis is evaluated in the Emergency Department. Standard universal precautions are taken. Which of the following is the most appropriate infection control precaution during the assessment?
r: TB وmeasles وvaricella ← Airborne. Influenza ← Droplet. C. diff ← Contact.

q: A 38-year-old woman who is not known to have any medical illness is referred to the clinic because of a chest x-ray that showed prominent hilar structures bilaterally. She is having onand-off cough but denies any history of shortness of breath, sputum production, chest pain, skin lesions, weight loss, fever, or contact with sick people. She is not a smoker. Examination reveals clear chest bilaterally (see lab results and reports). CT chest: Confirmed bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy, otherwise lung parenchyma was clear. CT-guided biopsy: Showed noncaseating granuloma. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Asymptomatic stage I sarcoid ← Observe. أعراض أو organ involvement ← Prednisone.
kw: denies any history of shortness of breath

q: A 70-year-old man presented to the Emergency Department complaining of increasing shortness of breath and a productive cough for the past 5 months. He has been a smoker for over 50 years. Over the course of 5 months, he complained of malaise, night sweats, fever, and has lost 10 kg over the last 3 months. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: لو apical infiltrate + prison/homeless ← TB. لو fever حاد وقصير ← Pneumonia.
kw: productive cough for the past 5 months

q: A 42-year-old homeless man was recently released from prison. He presented to the Emergency Room with a fever, productive cough, weight loss, and night sweats over the past 3 months (see report). Chest X-ray: Left lung apical infiltration. Sputum sample was collected and sent to the lab. Which of the following tests has the highest diagnostic value?
r: Ziehl-Neelsen ← AFB (TB). Thick/thin film ← Malaria.

q: A 46-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with back pain for 3 weeks associated with fever. She was sent home with NSAIDs and bed rest recommendations but returned after 2 days with the inability to move her legs. Examination revealed a febrile patient with tenderness in the mid-back and upper motor neuron signs in the lower limbs associated with weakness 3/5 (see lab results and report). MRI spine: Diffuse discitis in T6 vertebrae. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Perform a bone marrow aspiration for culture
r: لو exposure لحليب/ماشية ← Brucella titers. لو TB endemic ← PPD/biopsy.
kw: upper motor neuron signs in the lower limbs
back pain for 3 weeks associated with fever

q: A 44-year-old man is presented to the Emergency Room 8 hours after the sudden onset of a global, severe headache with associated neck stiffness. The headache is described as the strongest he has ever had. He is known to have hypertension but is noncompliant with his medications. Examination revealed a discomfortable and restless patient. Funduscopic examination is normal with the left pupil being 2 millimeters larger than the right and poorly reactive to light, and he has neck stiffness with passive movement (see report). Which of the following is the most appropriate next diagnostic test?
o: Magnetic resonance angiography of the neck
r: لو CT خلال ٦ ساعات طبيعي ← ما تحتاجين LP. بعد ٦ ساعات أو الشك عالي ← LP.
kw: sudden onset of a global, severe headache

q: A 38-year-old woman known to have type 2 diabetes mellitus just returned from Makkah. She complains of fever, lethargy, and headache. She has no cough, chest pain, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, or skin rash. Examination reveals a drowsy patient with positive neck stiffness (see report). Lumbar puncture: Low glucose, markedly increased protein, WBC 9000 with predominantly neutrophils. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication to start?
r: لو عمر فوق ٥٠ أو immunocompromised ← أضيفي Ampicillin (Listeria). Bacterial meningitis ← Ceftriaxone + vancomycin.
kw: Low glucose, markedly increased protein, WBC 9000 with predominantly neutrophils

q: A 17-year-old man developed febrile neutropenia and shock post-chemotherapy for lymphoma. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial antibiotic?
r: لو stable ← Piperacillin-tazobactam أو cefepime. مع shock ← Meropenem. Vancomycin بس لو catheter/skin/MRSA.

q: A 33-year-old woman was admitted to the hospital after a road traffic accident that resulted in multiple fractures and had undergone multiple orthopedic surgical procedures. She has a positive urinary culture for Candida albicans. She denies any history of fever or urinary symptoms. She had an indwelling urinary catheter. Her examination is unremarkable. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Candiduria بدون أعراض ← شيلي الـcatheter وبدون antifungal. لو symptomatic/neutropenic ← Fluconazole.
kw: positive urinary culture for Candida albicans
denies any history of fever or urinary symptoms

q: A patient with acute leukemia recently underwent allogenic bone marrow transplantation. After 2 weeks, she was neutropenic and developed a fever and cough. She was diagnosed with invasive aspergillosis based on radiological and microbiological assessment. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
r: Aspergillus ← Voriconazole. Candida ← Echinocandin. Mucor ← Amphotericin.

q: A 69-year-old man is diagnosed recently with lymphoma and started on chemotherapy. On day 7 post 4th cycle, he presented to the Emergency Room with fever. Examination precludes any underlying infection (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
o: Blood culture and wait for sensitivity
Empiric IV antibiotics in a hospital setting
r: Febrile neutropenia ← Empiric IV antibiotics فورًا في المستشفى. بس low-risk ممكن oral.

q: A 55-year-old man with acute myeloid leukemia on chemotherapy presents to the Emergency Room with a 1-day history of fever. His physical examination is unremarkable. His chest radiograph and urinalysis are normal. Blood and urinary cultures are taken (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Febrile neutropenia ← IV antibiotics فورًا. لو الحرارة استمرت ٤–٧ أيام ← أضيفي antifungal.
kw: chest radiograph and urinalysis are normal
Blood and urinary cultures are taken

q: A 20-year-old woman, recently married, presents with burning micturition for one week. Physical examination reveals suprapubic tenderness (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate antibiotic?
r: Uncomplicated cystitis ← Nitrofurantoin. لو fever/flank pain ← Pyelonephritis.

q: A 25-year-old woman received the first dose of the human papilloma virus vaccine 3 months ago and visited the clinic today. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Wait another 3 months, then give the first dose again
r: HPV vaccine جدول ٣ جرعات: ٠، ١–٢، ٦ شهور. فاتت بعد ٣ شهور ← أعطي الجرعة التالية اليوم.
kw: received the first dose of the human papilloma virus vaccine 3 months ago

q: A 20-year-old woman presented to the clinic with dysuria and suprapubic pain. No fever. Urine dipstick done (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Send culture and wait for results
r: Uncomplicated cystitis ← Empiric treatment بدون انتظار culture.

q: A 33-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Room with sudden severe abdominal pain for the last three hours, sharp in nature, and radiating to the right shoulder. She states that her cycles are irregular, and her LMP was six weeks ago. Examination reveals guarding and rigidity. Which of the following is the best option for this patient's management?
r: Peritonism + shoulder pain ← Laparotomy (مو methotrexate).
kw: sharp in nature, and radiating to the right shoulder

q: A 30-year-old woman with a diagnosis of systemic lupus erythematosus who was maintained on mycophenolate mofetil 1 gm/day, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg/day, and prednisone 5 mg/day for the last 1 year. She has had inactive disease for more than 6 months. She is planning to get pregnant (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate action at this time?
o: Discontinue mycophenolate mofetil and start azathioprine
Discontinue mycophenolate mofetil and start methotrexate
r: لو ما تخطط حمل ← كمّلي mycophenolate. لو المرض نشط ← لا تحملين لين يهدأ ٦ شهور.
kw: inactive disease for more than 6 months

q: A 29-year-old woman presented in labor at 41 weeks' gestation and progressed well to vaginal delivery. The placenta did not deliver spontaneously. A manual extraction of the placenta was attempted but failed, with the impression of adherent placenta to the uterus. The patient opted to keep her uterus. The placenta was ligated with suture as high as possible in the uterus, and she was placed on methotrexate treatment. Which of the following is the most likely complication of this management?
r: Conservative management للـaccreta ← Infection أشهر complication. نزيف ثاني.
kw: patient opted to keep her uterus

q: A 22-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Room at 10 weeks' gestation with severe left lower quadrant abdominal pain. Preliminary diagnosis is ruptured ectopic pregnancy. All her vital signs are within normal limits. Transvaginal ultrasound: Moderate free fluid in the abdominal cavity. Which of the following is the most important early indicator of ongoing bleeding in her case?
r: أبكر مؤشر لنزيف مستمر ← Tachycardia. Hypotension علامة متأخرة.
kw: most important early indicator of ongoing bleeding
Moderate free fluid in the abdominal cavity
vital signs are within normal limits

q: A 30-year-old 12 weeks pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed her fundal height is consistent with 19 weeks (see report). Ultrasound: Findings are consistent with molar pregnancy. Which of the following is the most appropriate approach in management?
r: Molar pregnancy ← Suction evacuation. ثم متابعة hCG أسبوعيًا.
kw: fundal height is consistent with 19 weeks

q: A 25-year-old woman presented to the clinic for antenatal care. Her last period was 6 weeks back. She is spotting on and off with no pain (see lab result and report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: No intrauterine pregnancy seen. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient and send her home
r: PUL بدون ألم + مستقرة ← Repeat BhCG بعد ٤٨ ساعة. لو ruptured/ unstable ← surgery.
kw: spotting on and off with no pain

q: A 26-year-old woman pregnant at 10 weeks was diagnosed with a molar pregnancy. After evacuation and curettage, she has been followed weekly with BhCG levels. The levels have not changed for the past month. Which of the following is the most appropriate management option?
o: As long as it’s not increasing, continue observation
r: hCG plateau/ارتفاع بعد mole ← GTN ← Oncology + methotrexate.
kw: levels have not changed for the past month

q: A 21-year-old woman pregnant at 8 weeks is diagnosed with a missed abortion. Which of the following is the most appropriate management option?
r: Missed abortion ← Misoprostol (أو expectant/surgical حسب الحالة).

q: A 15-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with pelvic pain and spotting. After reassessment, she was diagnosed with inevitable abortion and management options were given to her. After 15 minutes, she started to have severe bleeding and lost consciousness (see table). Which of the following is the most appropriate management plan?
r: Inevitable + نزيف شديد/shock ← D&C فورًا. مستقرة ← medical/expectant.

q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman in her 8th week presented to the Emergency Room with bleeding and reported passing vesicles. After assessing, her uterine size appears larger than the date. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Vesicles + uterus أكبر من العمر ← Molar pregnancy.
kw: uterine size appears larger than the date

q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with spotting and passing vesicles (see lab result and report). Ultrasound: Snowstorm appearance. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Snowstorm ← Molar pregnancy ← Suction evacuation (وليس medical).

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, whose last menstrual period was 7 weeks ago, presented to the Emergency Room with lower abdominal pain and moderate vaginal bleeding, passing tissue. Examination revealed an open cervix with tissue seen at the cervix. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: cervix مفتوح + tissue ← Incomplete abortion. مقفل + طلع tissue كامل ← Complete.
kw: open cervix with tissue seen at the cervix

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, whose last menstrual period was 7 weeks ago, presented to the Emergency Room with lower abdominal pain and vaginal spotting. Examination revealed a tender abdomen and a closed cervix (see lab results and report). Bedside ultrasound: No intrauterine pregnancy seen and moderate intra-abdominal fluid seen. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: لا IUP + free fluid + ألم ← Ectopic pregnancy.
kw: tender abdomen and a closed cervix

q: A 20-year-old woman at 6 weeks gestation is receiving methotrexate treatment for an ectopic pregnancy. The first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² IM was administered one week ago. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels on days 1, 4, and 7 were as follows: Day 1: 1000 mIU/mL Day 4: 1200 mIU/mL Day 7: 1100 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Administer a second dose of methotrexate
r: hCG يوم ٧ أقل من ١٥٪ من يوم ٤ ← Second dose methotrexate.
kw: first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² IM was administered one week ago

q: A 30-year-old woman at 6 weeks gestation is receiving methotrexate treatment for an ectopic pregnancy. The first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² IM was administered one week ago. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels on days 1, 4, and 7 were as follows: Day 1: 1000 mIU/mL Day 4: 1200 mIU/mL Day 7: 800 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Administer a second dose of methotrexate
r: hCG نزل ≥ ١٥٪ (١٢٠٠ ← ٨٠٠) ← Repeat BhCG أسبوعيًا.
kw: first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² IM was administered one week ago

q: A 30-year-old woman at 6 weeks gestation is receiving methotrexate treatment for an ectopic pregnancy. The first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² IM was administered one week ago. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels on days 1, 4, and 7 were as follows: Day 1: 1000 mIU/mL Day 4: 1200 mIU/mL Day 7: 2100 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Administer a second dose of methotrexate
r: hCG يرتفع بقوة ← فشل methotrexate ← Surgery.
kw: first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² IM was administered one week ago

q: A healthy 20-year-old woman at 6 weeks' gestation with a diagnosis of ectopic pregnancy has received a first dose of methotrexate 50mg/m² IM 14 days ago. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels were as follows: Day 1: 1000 mIU/mL Day 4: 1200 mIU/mL Day 7: 800 mIU/mL Day 14: 500 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Administer a second dose of methotrexate
r: hCG ينزل بشكل مطلوب ← استمري المتابعة الأسبوعية لين يصير سلبي (لا تقفين).
kw: first dose of methotrexate 50mg/m² IM 14 days ago

q: The first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² was administered intramuscularly 14 days ago to a healthy 20-year-old woman at 6 weeks gestation with a diagnosis of ectopic pregnancy. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels were as follows: Day 1: 1000 mIU/mL Day 4: 1200 mIU/mL Day 7: 1500 mIU/mL Day 14: 2210 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Administer a second dose of methotrexate
Administer a multiple methotrexate dose regimen
r: hCG يرتفع بعد methotrexate ← قيمي TVUS (rupture؟) ثم surgery. لو نزل ← متابعة.
kw: first dose of methotrexate 50 mg/m² was administered intramuscularly 14 days ago

q: A 20-year-old primigravida woman at 7 weeks' gestation is diagnosed with a 4-cm stable right tubal ectopic pregnancy. She has no clinical symptoms. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Ectopic ≥ ٣.٥–٤ سم أو fetal heartbeat ← Surgery. أقل من ٣.٥ سم ومستقر ← Methotrexate.

q: A 32-year-old patient became pregnant through in-vitro fertilization. She is now 7 weeks pregnant and is scheduled for laparoscopic surgical excision of an ectopic pregnancy (see report). Ultrasound: Presence of a right-sided 4-cm ectopic pregnancy and a left tubal hydrosalpinx. Which of the following is the most appropriate procedure?
o: Excision of both right and left tubes
r: IVF + hydrosalpinx بالجهة الثانية ← Bilateral salpingectomy (يرفع نجاح IVF).

q: A 33-year-old patient presents with vaginal spotting for the last 3 days. She is 7 weeks pregnant, and the transvaginal scan does not reveal an intrauterine or extrauterine gestational sac. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
o: Repeat lab and ultrasound evaluation in 48 hours
r: PUL مستقرة ← Repeat hCG وultrasound بعد ٤٨ ساعة. لا methotrexate قبل التأكد.
kw: does not reveal an intrauterine or extrauterine gestational sac
vaginal spotting for the last 3 days

q: A 35-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Room with sudden severe abdominal pain for the last three hours, sharp and radiating to the right shoulder. She has an irregular menstrual cycle, and the last episode was six weeks ago (see report). Pelvic ultrasound: Abundant fluid collected in the pouch of Douglas. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Shoulder pain + free fluid + amenorrhea ← Ruptured ectopic.
kw: Abundant fluid collected in the pouch of Douglas
last episode was six weeks ago

q: A pregnant patient presents with an ultrasound image resembling a snowstorm appearance. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Snowstorm ← Molar pregnancy (complete mole).

q: A 31-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Department with severe abdominal pain, dizziness, and mild vaginal bleeding. Her last menstrual cycle was 7 weeks ago with a positive pregnancy test. Examination revealed a distended abdomen and severe tenderness with guarding (see report). Pelvic Ultrasound: Free fluid in the cul-de-sac, and no gestational sac is seen. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Dizziness + guarding + free fluid + no sac ← Ruptured ectopic.

q: A 33-year-old woman presents at 9 weeks of gestation with mild vaginal bleeding. Examination of her abdomen reveals mild tenderness without rigidity or rebound tenderness. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervix (see lab result and report). Ultrasound: Does not reveal any intrauterine or extrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: PUL stable + hCG عالي (مفتاح) ← Methotrexate. لو hCG منخفض/ يتابع ← انتظري ٤٨ ساعة.
kw: Ultrasound: Does not reveal any intrauterine or extrauterine pregnancy

q: A 35-year-old woman presents with severe generalized abdominal pain, associated with nausea and vomiting for the last few hours. She is known to have an intrauterine contraceptive device inserted for the last 3 years. She did a home pregnancy test, which was positive. Ultrasound: Fluid collection of approximately 13 x 15 cm. No identified gestational sac. Both ovaries are normal. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: IUD + حمل + free fluid كبير + no sac ← Ruptured ectopic.
kw: Fluid collection of approximately 13 x 15 cm

q: A 29-year-old woman arrives at the hospital in labor at 38 weeks gestation of an otherwise uncomplicated second pregnancy. Her labor fails to progress after 20 hours; a cesarean section delivers a healthy female infant. A few minutes after the procedure, the patient begins to have heavy vaginal bleeding. Placental abruption is diagnosed and appropriately managed with fluid resuscitation and transfusion of 4 units of blood, yet she continues to have moderate bleeding (see lab results). Which of the following infusion is the most appropriate management?
r: DIC + fibrinogen واطي ← Cryoprecipitate. لو platelets أقل من ٥٠ ← Platelets.
kw: yet she continues to have moderate bleeding

q: A 32-year-old woman presents with pain in her hands and knees on and off for 2 months. She had 3 abortions in the first trimester. Examination reveals a rash over the nose bridge, swelling and tenderness of the small joints of the hands, and a warm, tender, erythematous swelling of the right calf that is 2 cm larger in circumference than the left (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate venous thromboembolism prophylaxis in her case?
r: Antiphospholipid + VTE ← Lifelong warfarin (DOAC ما ينفع). لو حامل ← LMWH.
kw: swelling and tenderness of the small joints of the hands
right calf that is 2 cm larger

q: A 26-year-old woman primigravida tested positive on a home pregnancy test. Her last menstrual period was 36 days ago, and she usually has a 30-day cycle. Three weeks ago, she received a rubella vaccine and was advised not to become pregnant for 2 months after the vaccine. Which of the following is the most likely outcome?
o: Intrauterine fetal death in the third trimester
Spontaneous abortion within the first trimester
r: Live vaccine بالغلط ← ما يزيد الـteratogenic risk (طمنيها). Rubella infection بأول ١٢ أسبوع ← خطر CRS عالي.
kw: advised not to become pregnant for 2 months
last menstrual period was 36 days ago

q: A 40-year-old G9 P6026 at 9 weeks' gestation presents with vaginal spotting and mild abdominal pain. Ultrasound shows a 5-week gestational size and no fetal heart detected. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: مستقرة ← Expectant management. لو نزيف شديد أو infection ← Evacuation.
kw: vaginal spotting and mild abdominal pain

q: A 23-year-old primigravida is admitted with threatened preterm labor at 30 weeks' gestation and has received antenatal corticosteroids. Which of the following is the rationale behind corticosteroid administration in this case?
r: Steroids ← نضج الرئة (↓ RDS، IVH، NEC).

q: A 30-year-old G3 P0020 at 17 weeks gestation is undergoing serial ultrasound assessments of cervical length due to a history of a previous second-trimester abortion. Which of the following features will indicate cervical cerclage before 24 weeks gestation?
r: Cerclage قبل ٢٤ أسبوع: cervical length أقل من ٢٥ مم + history. Funneling وحده لا.
kw: history of a previous second-trimester abortion

q: A 22-year-old primigravida with Type 1 diabetes presents at 32 weeks' gestation with regular painful contractions and a closed cervix. Which of the following is the most appropriate antenatal management?
o: Steroids, additional insulin, and tocolytic agent
r: Preterm labor عند diabetic ← Steroids + زيادة insulin (steroids ترفع glucose) + Tocolytic.
kw: regular painful contractions and a closed cervix

q: A 40-year-old G4 P2012 at 41+5 weeks had undergone induction of labor by prostaglandin in the last 6 hours. She suddenly developed vaginal bleeding and shock. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Induction + shock + نزيف ← Ruptured uterus (خصوصًا multiparous/previous scar). لو ألم + uterus صلب ← Abruption.
kw: suddenly developed vaginal bleeding and shock

q: A 37-year-old woman G4 P3003 at 40 weeks' gestation presents in labor and progresses to vaginal delivery. Placenta delivery is complicated with inverted uterus and 1200 cc of vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is most likely the cause of her postpartum bleeding?
o: Inadequate effect of the myometrial contractions
Local coagulopathy of the endometrium and myometrium
r: الـinversion يسبب atony (Inadequate myometrial contraction) ← عالجي reduction وuterotonics.

q: A 35-year-old G9 P6026 at 8 weeks' gestation presents to the hospital with vaginal spotting associated with very mild lower abdominal pain. She has noticed some dark brown clots. Examination reveals she is comfortable in bed with no abdominal tenderness appreciated. Pelvic examination reveals minimal dark-red clots in the introitus and cervical os closed (see report). Transvaginal ultrasound: 5-week gestational size with no fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step of management plan?
r: Missed/early failure مستقر ← Expectant. لو نزيف شديد/infection ← Suction curettage.
kw: 5-week gestational size with no fetal heart

q: A 27-year-old G4 P2103 woman presents at 37 weeks' gestation with moderately severe vaginal bleeding (see image and report). Ultrasound: 32 weeks' gestation, with low-lying placenta covering part of the cervix. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Digital examination to assess the cervix
r: Placenta previa + نزيف شديد ← Cesarean. لا Digital exam أبدًا.
kw: low-lying placenta covering part of the cervix

q: A 23-year-old woman primigravida presents at 27 weeks' gestation with vaginal bleeding. She undergoes a transvaginal ultrasound showing a placenta previa. Which of the following is the most likely associated feature?
o: Profuse first episode of vaginal bleeding
r: Previa ← نزيف بدون ألم (painless) وممكن postcoital spotting. Abruption ← مؤلم.

q: A 24-year-old woman primigravida undergoes an uneventful vaginal delivery at term. After placental delivery, she has 1000 cc of vaginal bleeding. She is alert, and her vital signs are stable, with the uterus noted to be firm. Which of the following is the most common cause?
r: Uterus صلب + نزيف ← Genital tract laceration. Uterus رخو ← Atony.

q: A 39-year-old G8 P5126 at 38 weeks' gestation presents for induction of labor due to decreased fetal movement. She is started on oxytocin and begins having contractions. After several hours of labor, her cervix dilates to 6 cm, but she then develops a fever and fetal tachycardia. A diagnosis of chorioamnionitis is entertained. She delivers a baby boy vaginally 4 hours later, but afterward, there is a large continuous vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her bleeding?
r: Chorioamnionitis ← Atony (التهاب يضعف contraction).

q: A 30-year-old woman had a spontaneous vaginal delivery for a term twin pregnancy 2 hours ago. Now she has active vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her bleeding?
r: Twin/ polyhydramnios/ macrosomia ← Uterine atony (أكثر سبب للـPPH).

q: A 34-year-old G2 P1001 at 33 weeks gestation presents with vaginal bleeding associated with clots. No abdominal pain or labor-like pain has been reported. Ultrasound: The placenta is covering the cervical internal os. Which of the following is the most likely predisposing factor for this case?
r: Previa risk: previous CS، multiple gestation، advanced age، smoking. بدون ألم ← Previa.
kw: placenta is covering the cervical internal os

q: A 37-year-old G3 P1011 at 28 weeks' gestation had vaginal spotting 2 weeks ago but no abdominal cramping or passing any clots or tissue. Examination reveals fundal height equivalent to 18 weeks' size. Ultrasound confirms lack of fetal heart activity and no fetal movement. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: أكثر من ٢٠ أسبوع بدون fetal heart ← Fetal demise (IUFD). أقل ← Missed abortion.
kw: fundal height equivalent to 18 weeks' size

q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman with 7 weeks' amenorrhea presented to the clinic with a history of passing tissue at home and vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed mild vaginal bleeding with a closed cervix. Which of the following is the most likely abortion type?
r: Passed tissue + cervix مقفل + نزيف خفيف ← Complete abortion. cervix مفتوح ← Incomplete.

q: A 33-year-old 7 weeks' pregnant woman presented with mild vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed a closed cervix. Ultrasound: A 7-week viable intrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion she had?
r: Bleeding + cervix مقفل + fetus حي ← Threatened abortion. Missed ← fetus ميت.

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time, missing her period. LMP was 9 weeks ago, and she had a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with mild bleeding. Transvaginal ultrasonography: Intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length of 9 weeks of gestation with positive embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?
r: Heartbeat موجود + cervix مقفل ← Threatened. لو لا heartbeat ← Missed abortion.

q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman presented with abdominal cramps and mild vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed an open cervix with mild bleeding. Ultrasound: A 7-week viable intrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion she had?
r: Cervix مفتوح + fetus حي ← Inevitable abortion. بعد ما يطلع tissue ← Incomplete.

q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman presented with a history of vaginal bleeding and passed tissue at home. Examination revealed an open cervix. Ultrasound: Intrauterine tissue. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion she had?
r: Tissue طلع + cervix مفتوح + tissue بالرحم ← Incomplete abortion.

q: A 33-year-old 7 weeks' pregnant woman presented with vaginal bleeding and a history of passing tissue at home. Examination revealed an open cervix with moderate vaginal bleeding. Ultrasound: Intrauterine 3x4 cm tissue seen. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Incomplete + نزيف ← Evacuation. لو نزيف قليل ← expectant أو misoprostol.
kw: open cervix with moderate vaginal bleeding

q: A 30-year-old 7 weeks' pregnant woman presented with mild vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed a closed cervix. Ultrasound: 7 weeks' viable intrauterine pregnancy. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: Threatened abortion ← Conservative (راحة ومتابعة). لا D&C.

q: A 30-year-old 33 weeks' pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with lower abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: نزيف بالثلث الثالث: ابدئي ABC أول (٢ IV lines كبيرة) قبل فحص أو scan. لا vaginal exam قبل exclude previa.
kw: lower abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding

q: A 33-year-old 32 weeks' pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with mild painless vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
o: Observe the bleeding over an hour
r: نزيف بدون ألم ← Placenta previa ← ultrasound لتحديد الـplacenta قبل أي فحص مهبلي.

q: A 26-year-old 9 weeks pregnant woman, presented with vaginal bleeding and subsequently had a spontaneous abortion. Which of the following is the most common cause?
r: أشيع سبب لـearly miscarriage ← Chromosomal abnormality.

q: A 10-week pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with a history of abdominal cramping and vaginal bleeding. She passed some tissue at home. Examination revealed normal vital signs with a closed cervix (see report). Ultrasound: Shows an empty uterus. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: Complete abortion مستقر ← Reassure. لو tissue باقي ← Evacuation.

q: A 29-year-old woman presented to the clinic unsure of her gestational age. She missed her period 3 months ago but her periods are irregular (see report). Ultrasound: Determined gestational age as 11 weeks. Which of the following was measured in the ultrasound to determine gestational age?
r: الأول ← Crown-rump length (أدق للـfirst trimester).

q: A 28-year-old woman had a spontaneous abortion at 8 weeks. She is concerned regarding the cause of her abortion. Which of the following is the most common cause?
r: Early miscarriage ← Chromosomal abnormalities. لو recurrent second-trimester ← cervical insufficiency.

q: A 28-year-old pregnant woman presented at 20 weeks with spotting. No history of trauma. Her blood group is O negative (see report). Ultrasound: Normal-sized fetus, normal placentation, and long cervix. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: Rh-negative + bleeding ← Anti-D.

q: A 25-year-old pregnant woman in her 10th week presented with spotting and pain. Examination revealed the uterus was larger than expected and pelvic examination showed vesicles passing through the internal os. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Molar pregnancy ← Serum hCG + Ultrasound ثم evacuation.
kw: vesicles passing through the internal os

q: A 31-year-old woman presented with a positive pregnancy test to the antenatal clinic. She is not sure of her last menstrual period as she is lactating. Pelvic ultrasound was requested for dating her pregnancy. Which of the following parameters has the highest diagnostic value for dating pregnancy?
r: الـCRL أدق parameter بالـfirst trimester.
kw: not sure of her last menstrual period
highest diagnostic value for dating pregnancy

q: A 29-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with a very heavy period. She is morbidly obese and diabetic. Her periods are irregular, occurring every 3-4 months. She had her period 2 weeks ago and it has not stopped, with heavy clots. Pregnancy test is negative. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Obese + DM + دورة كل ٣–٤ شهور ← Chronic anovulation (PCOS) ← unopposed estrogen.

q: A 28-year-old G1 P0 woman presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with abdominal pain with no leaking or bleeding. The CTG shows a normal heart rate with regular contractions 4 in 10 minutes. She was admitted with preterm labor, as her cervix was 2 cm dilated and 80% effaced. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: This is a threatened preterm labor, so observation
r: Preterm labor: Dexamethasone + Tocolytic (nifedipine) + GBS prophylaxis.
kw: cervix was 2 cm dilated and 80% effaced

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with profuse vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain. CTG showed a normal heart rate with regular contractions. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: نزيف + ألم + contractions ← Abruption. نزيف بدون ألم ← Previa.
kw: profuse vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, who has been missing her clinic appointments, presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with profuse vaginal bleeding. She had no pain, and the baby was moving well. CTG showed a normal heart rate with no contractions. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: نزيف شديد بدون ألم + بدون contractions ← Placenta previa.

q: A 25-year-old woman G1 P0 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with regular uterine contractions. She had no vaginal bleeding or leaking. CTG showed a normal heart rate and four contractions in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient and discharge home
Perform an ultrasound to check fetal weight
Perform a vaginal exam to assess cervical dilation
r: تأكيد preterm labor ← Vaginal exam لتقييم cervix. contractions وحدها لا تكفي.

q: A 29-year-old woman presents to the clinic with 3-month postpartum abnormal vaginal bleeding. An examination reveals a fleshy vaginal mass protruding from the cervix that bleeds on touch (see report). Ultrasound: A mass protruding from the cervix, involving the uterine cavity. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: Mass بعد ولادة تنزف + hCG ← شك Choriocarcinoma ← Metastatic workup (بدون biopsy).
kw: fleshy vaginal mass protruding from the cervix that bleeds on touch

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time after missing her period, with a positive home pregnancy test. Her last menstrual period was 5 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with no bleeding (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with no embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Sac بدون heartbeat عند ٥ أسابيع ← Uncertain viability (مبكر). عند CRL ≥ ٧ مم ← missed.
kw: intrauterine gestational sac with no embryonic heartbeat
last menstrual period was 5 weeks ago

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time after missing her period, LMP 9 weeks ago, and with a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with no bleeding (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length of 9 weeks' gestation with no embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?
r: CRL ٩ أسابيع بدون heartbeat + cervix مقفل ← Missed abortion.
kw: crown-rump length of 9 weeks' gestation with no embryonic heartbeat

q: A 34-year-old woman presents at 10 weeks of gestation to the Emergency Department with fetal death, without expulsion of any fetal tissue for at least 8 weeks. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?
r: Fetal demise بدون expulsion ← Missed abortion.
kw: without expulsion of any fetal tissue for at least 8 weeks

q: An 18-year-old primigravida presents to the clinic for the first time after she missed her period, LMP 9 weeks ago, and with a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals an open cervical os with membranes protruding through the cervix (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length of 9 weeks' gestation with a positive embryonic heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Open cervix + sac برز + heartbeat ← Inevitable miscarriage.

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of vaginal bleeding and feeling unwell. She missed her period and has a positive home pregnancy test. Her last menstrual period was 9 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals an open cervical os with the gestational sac protruding through the cervix (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: An intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length corresponding to 9 weeks' gestation with a positive heartbeat. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: نفس الصورة + مريضة مو بخير/ fever ← Septic miscarriage.
kw: gestational sac protruding through the cervix

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping. She has a positive home pregnancy test, and her last menstrual period was 9 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervix with bleeding noted through (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasound: Intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length corresponding to 9 weeks' gestation with a positive heartbeat. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment plan?
o: Reassure and evaluate after 1 week's duration
Admit, stabilize, and prepare for possible termination of pregnancy
r: Threatened مستقر ← Reassure ومتابعة. المفتاح: Admit وstabilize (حسب السؤال).

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of mild vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping. Her last period was 9 weeks ago, and she has a positive home pregnancy test (see report). Transvaginal Ultrasonography: Intrauterine gestational sac with a crown-rump length corresponding to 9 weeks' gestation with a positive heartbeat. Which of the following would be the most appropriate next step?
r: Bleeding بالأول ← Pelvic assessment (speculum + bimanual) لتقييم cervix.
kw: mild vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping

q: A 17-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of mild vaginal bleeding and abdominal cramping. She missed her period along with a positive home pregnancy test, and her LMP was 6 weeks ago. Pelvic examination reveals an open cervical os with mild vaginal bleeding through the cervix. Which of the following would be the most appropriate next step?
o: Reassure the patient and evaluate in 10 days
r: نزيف + cervix مفتوح ← Transvaginal ultrasound لتحديد النوع.
kw: open cervical os with mild vaginal bleeding

q: A 19-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Department complaining of abdominal cramps and mild vaginal bleeding. Her LMP was 6 weeks ago, with a positive home pregnancy test. Pelvic examination reveals a closed cervical os with abdominal pain on manipulation of the cervix. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Perform a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis
Perform a deeper pelvic assessment to rule out masses
r: Cervical motion tenderness + نزيف + ٦ أسابيع ← Transvaginal ultrasound (استبعدي ectopic).
kw: abdominal pain on manipulation of the cervix

q: A patient presents 3 weeks after vaginal delivery with sudden vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?
r: PPH أكثر من ٢٤ ساعة إلى ١٢ أسبوع ← Late (secondary) postpartum. أول ٢٤ ساعة ← Primary.

q: A patient presents 10 hours after vaginal delivery with sudden vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?
r: أول ٢٤ ساعة ← Early/primary postpartum hemorrhage.

q: A patient presents at 32 weeks of gestation with sudden vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?
r: نزيف بعد ٢٠ أسبوع قبل labor ← Antepartum hemorrhage.

q: A patient at 32 weeks of gestation is 7 cm dilated, suddenly develops vaginal bleeding of 700 cc. Which of the following is this type of bleeding?
r: نزيف أثناء labor ← Intrapartum hemorrhage.
kw: suddenly develops vaginal bleeding of 700 cc

q: A 33-year-old woman P2+3 is seen in the Emergency Department at 12 weeks of gestation with vaginal bleeding and lower abdominal pain. Digital pelvic examination revealed the cervix is partially dilated without passage of any products of conception. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?
r: Cervix مفتوح بدون expulsion ← Inevitable abortion.
kw: cervix is partially dilated without passage of any products of conception
vaginal bleeding and lower abdominal pain

q: A 25-year-old woman P1+1 presented at 13 weeks of gestation with vaginal bleeding. Abdominal examination revealed the uterus is palpable at the symphysis pubis with a positive fetal heart. Vaginal examination revealed a closed cervix. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?
r: Cervix مقفل + fetal heart موجود ← Threatened abortion.

q: A 23-year-old woman presented at 10 weeks of gestation with a history of vaginal bleeding, cramp-like pain, and passage of some placental tissue through the cervix. Which of the following is the most likely type of abortion?
r: Tissue طلع جزئيًا ← Incomplete abortion.
kw: passage of some placental tissue through the cervix

q: A 31-year-old woman is seen in the Antenatal Clinic. She gave a history of a previous recurrent abortion in the first trimester of pregnancy. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
r: Recurrent first-trimester loss ← Karyotyping (الزوجين) أول. Second-trimester ← uterine/cervical.
kw: recurrent abortion in the first trimester

q: A 39-year-old woman presented at 37 weeks of gestation with scanty vaginal bleeding. She is a known case of placenta previa totalis with a history of two previous episodes of vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most advisable time for admission?
o: If she has another episode of bleeding
r: Previa totalis + نزيف سابق ← Admit فورًا ثم planned cesarean.
kw: two previous episodes of vaginal bleeding

q: A 33-year-old woman, known case of low-lying placenta, presented at 35 weeks of gestation with mild vaginal bleeding at home. Examination revealed her vital signs are normal, and no more bleeding is noted. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Previa + نزيف خفيف وتوقف ← CTG لتقييم الجنين (ultrasound معروفة).

q: A 34-year-old woman at 27 weeks of gestation presented with preterm labor. She is started on Beta mimetics (tocolytics). Which of the following is the most common side effect?
r: Beta-agonist ← Palpitations/tachycardia (وhypokalemia وpulmonary edema).

q: A 24-year-old woman, known smoker, presented at 31 weeks of gestation with painful vaginal bleeding and uterine contractions. Fetal heart on CTG shows late decelerations. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: ألم + contractions + smoker ← Abruption. نزيف بدون ألم ← Previa.
kw: painful vaginal bleeding and uterine contractions

q: A 36-year-old woman with a previous history of two cesarean sections presented at 30 weeks of gestation with painless vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed, the uterus is soft, and the fetal heart rate is normal. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: بدون ألم + uterus طري + previous CS ← Placenta previa.

q: A 34-year-old pregnant woman at 36 weeks of gestation presented with acute painful vaginal bleeding associated with uterine tenderness. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: نزيف مؤلم + uterine tenderness ← Abruption.

q: A 30-year-old woman attends at 27 weeks of gestation with scanty vaginal bleeding. An ultrasound confirms placenta previa totalis. She is hemodynamically stable, and CTG is normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Previa مستقرة قبل ٣٤ أسبوع ← Steroids (احتمال preterm delivery) + admit.

q: A 35-year-old G8P7 woman presents in labor at 37 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix was found to be 10 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station. She suddenly complains of severe abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 80 beats per minute, poor variability with recurrent late decelerations. Uterine contractions suddenly stopped being recorded on the CTG trace. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Grand multipara + ألم + توقف contractions + bradycardia ← Uterine rupture ← Laparotomy فورًا.
kw: uterine contractions suddenly stopped being recorded
severe abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding

q: A 30-year-old woman delivered a 4.2 kg baby without an episiotomy being required. The placenta was completely delivered by continuous cord traction. Post-delivery, the patient started to have a sudden gush of heavy vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
o: Request blood for complete blood count
r: بعد delivery placenta كامل + macrosomia ← Check uterine contractility (atony أول).
kw: sudden gush of heavy vaginal bleeding

q: A 33-year-old woman G5P4 with a history of 4 previous cesarean sections presents at 37 weeks of gestation to the Emergency Room complaining of contractions that started 8 hours ago. The pain progressed to become severe with moderate vaginal bleeding, and low blood pressure. She became restless and hyperventilated. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Previous CS + labor + ألم شديد + shock ← Uterine rupture.

q: A 30-year-old woman at 36 weeks of gestation presents with painless vaginal bleeding for one day. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
r: نزيف بدون ألم بالثلث الثالث ← Ultrasound (لتحديد previa) قبل أي فحص مهبلي.
kw: painless vaginal bleeding for one day

q: A 50-year-old woman had a recent miscarriage and is inquiring if her age contributed to the miscarriage. Which of the following is the most appropriate response?
o: Age is not related to miscarriage
80% chance of miscarriage due to her age
r: العمر يرفع خطر miscarriage (≥ ٤٠ ← ٣٠–٥٠٪+). المفتاح: بين ١٠–٥٠٪.

q: A 23-year-old woman presents at 18 weeks of gestation with a sudden unexpected rupture of membranes followed by painless expulsion of products of conception. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Painless mid-trimester loss ← Cervical incompetence (cerclage بالحمل القادم).
kw: painless expulsion of products of conception

q: A 25-year-old woman in her mid-trimester of pregnancy presents with a sudden unexpected rupture of membranes followed by painless expulsion of the products of conception. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Painless + mid-trimester ← Cervical incompetence.
kw: painless expulsion of the products of conception

q: A 25-year-old woman was diagnosed to have a complete abortion at 10 weeks of gestation. The patient is a heavy smoker and smokes more than 20 cigarettes a day. She was not taking any folic acid or dietary supplements. Which of the following is the most likely risk that caused the miscarriage?
o: Smoking more than 20 cigarettes a day
r: Smoking > ٢٠ ← يزيد miscarriage. Folate يمنع NTD مو miscarriage.
kw: smokes more than 20 cigarettes a day

q: A 50-year-old otherwise healthy woman presents to the Emergency Room with a history of amenorrhea for the last 17 weeks. Examination revealed normal vital signs. The uterine size corresponds to 20 weeks of gestation and feels doughy. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
o: CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis
r: Doughy uterus أكبر من العمر + amenorrhea ← Molar pregnancy ← Ultrasound أول (snowstorm) ثم hCG.
kw: uterine size corresponds to 20 weeks of gestation and feels doughy

q: A 17-year-old patient presents with a period of amenorrhea for the last 18 weeks. The uterus is about 22 weeks in size and feels doughy and compressible. Ultrasound: A snowstorm appearance with no clearly identified fetal pole. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Snowstorm + بدون fetal pole + hCG عالي ← Complete mole. Partial ← fetal parts + triploidy.
kw: snowstorm appearance with no clearly identified fetal pole
uterus is about 22 weeks in size and feels doughy

q: A 30-year-old, 12 weeks pregnant woman presented to the Emergency Room with vaginal bleeding. Examination revealed her fundal height corresponded with 19 weeks of gestation. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Uterus أكبر من dates + نزيف ← Complete mole (hCG عالي، snowstorm).
kw: fundal height corresponded with 19 weeks of gestation

q: An 18-year-old patient presents with amenorrhea for the last 15 weeks. She complains of vaginal bleeding and passage of tissue that she describes as vesicles. Ultrasound: A grape-like structure is filling the uterine cavity completely. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Grape-like + vesicles ← Complete mole. Partial ← fetal tissue موجود.
kw: grape-like structure is filling the uterine cavity completely
passage of tissue that she describes as vesicles

q: A 44-year-old woman was just recently diagnosed with partial molar pregnancy, which was confirmed by histopathology. Which of the following is the most appropriate follow-up plan?
r: بعد mole (حتى partial) ← hCG أسبوعيًا لين سلبي ثم متابعة.

q: A 26-year-old woman primigravida at 16 weeks' gestation presents to the clinic complaining of nausea and vomiting. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this condition?
r: Hyperemesis بالمفتاح مرتبط بنقص folate. فكري بنقص folate لو macrocytic anemia.

q: A pregnant woman with prenatal diagnosis of Rhesus (Rh) alloimmunization had an ultrasound scan during follow-up. Which of the following is the most diagnostic sign?
o: Low fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) Doppler peak systolic velocity
r: Fetal ascites + skin edema = Hydrops (أشد). MCA Doppler PSV عالي ← فقر دم الجنين.

q: A 26-year-old average-size woman has delivered a baby boy within the last 24 hours. During the morning round in the post-partum ward, it was found that her blood group is B-, her husband is O+, and her son is A+. A 300-g dose of anti-D immunoglobulin was prescribed. Which of the following volume of fetal blood will be protected by the prescribed dose?
r: ٣٠٠ mcg anti-D يحمي من ~١٥ mL fetal red cells (≈ ٣٠ mL fetal whole blood).

q: A 36-year-old woman G2 P1 AO L1 at 32 weeks gestation presents for routine prenatal care. Past medical history is unremarkable. Current pregnancy has been uncomplicated, with occasional Braxton Hicks contractions and increasing non-pruritic vaginal discharge like cervical mucus. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Physiologic ← Follow-up. لو gush ماء ← PROM. لو pruritic/نتن ← infection.
kw: non-pruritic vaginal discharge like cervical mucus

q: A 22-year-old primigravida who is Rh-negative delivered an Rh-positive infant. She received routine prophylactic Rh immunoglobulin at 28 weeks of gestation. What dose of anti-D immunoglobulin should she receive after delivery?
r: بعد ولادة طفل Rh+ ← ٣٠٠ mcg anti-D خلال ٧٢ ساعة (حتى لو أخذت ٢٨ أسبوع).
kw: routine prophylactic Rh immunoglobulin at 28 weeks

q: A 41-year-old woman is seen at 34 weeks of gestation in the antenatal clinic with an ultrasound report confirming excessive amniotic fluid. Which of the following is the common cause?
r: Polyhydramnios ← Uncontrolled diabetes. Renal agenesis ← oligohydramnios.

q: A 30-year-old woman G3P2 is at 37 weeks of gestation. She is a case of Rh isoimmunization and the fetus is diagnosed with fetal anemia. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Fetal anemia عند ٣٧ أسبوع ← Immediate delivery. قبل ٣٥ ← Intrauterine transfusion.

q: A pregnant woman with preeclampsia has just delivered and has a lax uterus with moderate postpartum hemorrhage. Physical examination reveals no laceration or retained product of conception. Which of the following medical therapies is most recommended?
o: 20 units oxytocin in a 500 mL of D5W given intravenously
r: Uterine atony ← Oxytocin IV. مع preeclampsia تجنبي ergometrine (يرفع الضغط).
kw: no laceration or retained product of conception

q: A 22-year-old pregnant woman at 40 weeks of gestation was diagnosed with DVT and started on a therapeutic dose of heparin. The patient had a normal vaginal delivery. Shortly after a heparin injection, she sustained postpartum hemorrhage. The uterus was contracted and examination revealed no lacerations. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
r: PPH بسبب heparin ← Protamine sulfate. لو uterine atony ← Uterotonics.

q: A 32-year-old G2 Pi AO at 12 weeks of gestation. She is a known case of IDDM for 12 years and attended the Antenatal Clinic. Which of the following will most likely increase markedly in this patient?
r: Pregestational DM ← Congenital malformations. GDM ما يسبب malformations.

q: A 30-year-old G4 P3003 woman at 39 weeks' gestation delivered a baby boy weighing 30.5 kg. Upon delivery of her placenta, an inverted uterus was noted and successfully reduced. Which placental site was the most likely predisposing factor?
r: Uterine inversion ← Fundal placenta (+ traction زيادة). عالجي reduction فورًا.

q: A 25-year-old woman underwent a normal vaginal delivery at term. After 30 minutes, the placenta is still in place. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Attempt manual extraction of the placenta
r: Retained placenta ٣٠ دقيقة ← Manual extraction. لو نزيف شديد قبلها ← تدخل أبكر.

q: A 27-year-old woman primigravida has severe uterine bleeding that exceeds 700 cc after a normal vaginal delivery which does not respond to medical treatment. The obstetrician in charge decided to go for surgical management. The patient desires future pregnancies. Which of the following structures is the most appropriate to ligate in her case in order to stop the bleeding?
r: PPH فشل medical + تبي حمل ← Internal iliac artery ligation (أو B-Lynch). Hysterectomy last resort.
kw: does not respond to medical treatment
exceeds 700 cc after a normal vaginal delivery

q: A 30-year-old GS P3013 woman presented in labor at term. She had a vaginal delivery complicated by abruption placenta. She was then noted to have significant uterine bleeding. The team in charge noted she had bleeding from multiple venipuncture sites. Which of the following is the best next step in management?
r: Abruption + bleeding من أماكن كثيرة = DIC ← عالجي Coagulopathy أول.

q: A 38-year-old woman, known for low-lying placenta, delivered a normal vaginal delivery. One hour post-delivery, she had postpartum hemorrhage. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: PPH بعد ساعة ← Atony أشيع سبب (4 T's: Tone، Trauma، Tissue، Thrombin).

q: A 24-year-old woman just delivered her first baby with a birth weight of 2.7 kg while she was at 38 weeks of gestation. She is not known to have any medical or surgical history. She has a heavy gush of bleeding postpartum. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: PPH أشيع سبب ← Uterine atony.

q: A 45-year-old woman came to the clinic complaining of heavy periods lasting more than 10 days. Pregnancy test is negative and ultrasound is normal. Which of the following medication is the most appropriate to use?
r: Heavy menstrual bleeding ← Tranexamic acid.
kw: heavy periods lasting more than 10 days
Pregnancy test is negative and ultrasound is normal

q: A 36-year-old woman G4 P3 L2, whose previous pregnancies were delivered normally without complications, had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 5 hours of labor. She delivered a baby boy weighing 4600 g and, after placental delivery, started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?
r: Macrosomia ← Atony (risk factor).

q: A 36-year-old woman G4 P3 L2, whose previous pregnancies were delivered normally, had an uneventful twin pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 5 hours of labor. She delivered healthy twin boys weighing 2800 g and 2900 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?
r: Twins ← Atony/overdistension (risk factor للـPPH).
kw: healthy twin boys weighing 2800 g and 2900 g

q: A 32-year-old woman G4 P3 L2 had normal deliveries with no prenatal or postnatal complications. She had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 16 hours of labor. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?
r: Prolonged labor ← Atony (risk factor).

q: A 32-year-old woman G7 P6 L6 had normal deliveries with no prenatal or postnatal complications. She had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery after 7 hours of labor. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?
r: Grand multipara (≥ 5) ← Atony (risk factor).

q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 had an uneventful pregnancy and a spontaneous vaginal delivery after 2 hours of labor, just making it to the hospital. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following was her risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage?
r: Precipitous labor (أقل من ٣ ساعات) ← Atony/laceration.
kw: just making it to the hospital

q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication for managing her postpartum hemorrhage?
r: PPH medical: Oxytocin أول، ثم Misoprostol/Methergine/Carboprost (المفتاح Misoprostol).
kw: most appropriate medication for managing her postpartum hemorrhage

q: A 33-year-old woman is seen post-delivery with postpartum hemorrhage. She had a forceps delivery of a 3.7 kg baby. Examination revealed laceration of the cervix, vagina, and the perineal body. Which of the following is the most likely cause of postpartum hemorrhage?
r: Forceps + lacerations ← Genital tract trauma. الرحم صلب والنزيف مستمر.
kw: forceps delivery of a 3.7 kg baby
laceration of the cervix, vagina, and the perineal body

q: A 23-year-old woman, a known case of idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura, delivered at 39 weeks of gestation, and her delivery was complicated with postpartum hemorrhage. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: PPH عند ITP ← Platelet concentrate.

q: A 36-year-old woman has a normal vaginal delivery of a 4.2 kg baby. Post-delivery, she had a perineal laceration involving the rectal mucosa. Which of the following is the most likely degree of the laceration?
r: Rectal mucosa ← Fourth-degree. Third ← anal sphincter فقط.
kw: perineal laceration involving the rectal mucosa

q: A 22-year-old PG at 39 weeks of gestation admitted to the Labor Room with active labor. Initial cervical examination revealed 5 cm dilatation with 60% effacement and station was at -2. After 6 hours despite regular adequate contractions, abdominal examination revealed the presence of a retraction ring and vaginal examination showed cervical dilatation of 7 cm and station of -1. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Bandl's ring + تقدم بطيء ← Obstructed labor.

q: A 28-year-old PG presents at 34 weeks of pregnancy with constant abdominal pain and moderate bleeding. Her symphysiofundal height is 37 cm, and her uterus is tender and firm. CTG: Unprovoked decelerations. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: ألم + uterus صلب ← Abruption. نزيف بدون ألم + uterus طري ← Placenta previa.

q: A 27-year-old primigravida with a low-risk pregnancy is admitted at 32 weeks with antepartum hemorrhage and diagnosed with placental abruption. Bleeding settled with conservative management. Which of the following is the most appropriate antenatal care plan?
o: Reassure and continue with "low risk" care
Reclassify as "High Risk" pregnancy care with serial ultrasound for fetal growth
Reassure and continue with "low risk" care and serial ultrasound for signs of bleeding
r: بعد abruption ← High-risk care + serial growth scans.

q: A 30-year-old woman with known sickle cell trait attends an antenatal booking clinic at 8 weeks' gestation. Which of the following antenatal complications is significantly more common in her case?
r: Trait ← UTI أكثر. Disease ← crises وIUGR وpreeclampsia.

q: A 36-year-old G4 P3003 is admitted in preterm labor at 36+5 weeks with polyhydramnios. Fetal bradycardia is noted after spontaneous rupture of membranes. Which of the following needs to be excluded by a prompt vaginal examination?
r: Polyhydramnios + rupture + bradycardia ← Cord prolapse ← فحص مهبلي فورًا + C-section.

q: A 36-year-old G3 P2002 with 2 previous caesarean sections is diagnosed with major placenta previa and placenta accreta at 32 weeks' gestation. When is an elective caesarean section recommended for delivery?
r: Previa بدون accreta ← ٣٨ أسبوع. Accreta ← ٣٤–٣٧ أسبوع (المفتاح ٣٦–٣٧).

q: A 30-year-old married, nulligravid woman with symptomatic multiple uterine fibroids, all subserosal, underwent myomectomy. According to her operative note, the endometrial cavity was entered during surgery. What is the risk of placenta accreta during future pregnancies?
r: المفتاح: Not affected. (accreta مرتبط أكثر بـprevious CS + previa).
kw: endometrial cavity was entered during surgery

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 presented 3 days ago to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with preterm premature rupture of membranes. She was managed expectantly and today she started to have fever and abdominal pain. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: PPROM + fever + ألم ← Chorioamnionitis.

q: A 26-year-old woman presents at 29 weeks of gestation with prelabor premature rupture of membranes for 7 days. Examination revealed she is having lower abdominal pain, rigors, and fever with purulent, foul-smelling vaginal discharge. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: PPROM + fever + discharge نتن ← Chorioamnionitis.
kw: prelabor premature rupture of membranes for 7 days

q: A 35-year-old woman with a history of three previous cesarean sections is admitted for elective surgery at 37 weeks of gestation. The placenta is found to be attached deeply into the uterus. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Attached للعضلة ← Accreta (increta عميق في العضلة، percreta تخترق).
kw: placenta is found to be attached deeply into the uterus
elective surgery at 37 weeks of gestation

q: A 33-year-old woman diagnosed with abruptio placentae presented with intrauterine fetal death. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 5 cm dilated with mild uterine contractions. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: IUFD + abruption + labor قائمة ← Augmentation (vaginal delivery). Cesarean لو نزيف كثير.
kw: cervix is found to be 5 cm dilated

q: A 30-year-old woman presented to the maternity unit at 30 weeks of gestation with massive antepartum hemorrhage. CTG is showing fetal distress. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Massive APH + fetal distress ← Cesarean فورًا.

q: A 34-year-old woman at 38 weeks gestation is evaluated for a severe headache. Her only medication is a prenatal vitamin. Neurologic and cardiopulmonary examination is normal. She has a gravid uterus and 2+ edema of the lower extremities. No petechiae or ecchymoses are seen (see lab results and report). Peripheral smear: Occasional fragmented erythrocytes without platelet clumping. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: حمل ٣٨ أسبوع + preeclampsia/HELLP ← Delivery. لو TTP (بدون حمل) ← Plasma exchange.

q: A 39-year-old woman presented to the family medicine clinic for counseling as she is planning to get pregnant. She gave a history of hypertension and is controlled on an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEI). Her physician asked her to change the medication as it is contraindicated during pregnancy. Which of the following is the most likely effect of ACEI on pregnancy?
o: Increases the rate of fetal malformation
Increases the rate of premature rupture of membranes
Leads to a significant drop in blood pressure during pregnancy
r: الـACEi/ARB ← fetal malformation (المفتاح)، وبالثلث ٢–٣ renal dysgenesis. البديل ← Methyldopa/labetalol/nifedipine.

q: A 28-year-old Primigravida at 8 weeks of gestation is known to have chronic hypertension and presented to Antenatal Clinic. Which of the following antihypertensive medications is contraindicated?
r: آمنة بالحمل: labetalol، nifedipine، methyldopa. الممنوعة: ACE inhibitors/ARB.

q: A 28-year-old G4 P3 AO at 12 weeks of gestation with a prior history of preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction presented to the Antenatal Clinic. Which of the following will most likely reduce the risk of growth restriction and preeclampsia?
r: Aspirin (٧٥–١٥٠ mg) من ١٢ أسبوع يقلل preeclampsia وFGR.
kw: prior history of preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction

q: A 28-year-old diabetic on insulin with no significant family history is concerned about pregnancy. Which of the following risks is the same for her as for the general population?
r: DM ← hydramnios، macrosomia، preeclampsia تزيد. Cystic fibrosis (وراثي) ما يتأثر.
kw: same for her as for the general population

q: A 30-year-old PG at 30 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia complaining of right upper quadrant abdominal pain. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
r: RUQ pain في preeclampsia ← Liver capsule distension (HELLP/eclampsia وشيك).

q: A 27-year-old G3 P2 AO L2 at 34 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia. Which of the following is the rationale behind giving antihypertensive medications?
o: Decrease risk of maternal complications such as stroke
r: Antihypertensive يحمي الأم (stroke)، ما يحسن نتيجة الجنين.

q: A 30-year-old G4 P3 AO L3 at 34 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia. Which of the following is most likely to be decreased significantly?
r: Preeclampsia ← Plasma volume ينزل، وurea وuric acid وcreatinine ترتفع.

q: A 30-year-old primigravida at 30 weeks of gestation newly diagnosed with preeclampsia. Which of the following antihypertensives is contraindicated?
r: Captopril (ACE inhibitor) ممنوع. الآمنة: nifedipine، hydralazine، labetalol، methyldopa.

q: A 23-year-old primigravida admitted for induction of labor. The cervix is closed and 3.5 cm long. Which of the following is the most appropriate agent to be given to her for cervical ripening?
r: Unfavorable cervix ← Prostaglandin E2. Favorable ← Oxytocin.
kw: cervix is closed and 3.5 cm long

q: A 38-year-old primigravida at 35 weeks gestation complains of a mild headache and facial edema. Her reflexes are brisk, and she is suspected of having preeclampsia. Which of the following is likely to show in the urinalysis?
r: Preeclampsia ← Proteinuria (٣٠٠ mg/24h أو أكثر).

q: A 19-year-old primigravida is referred at 32 weeks' gestation due to raised blood pressure. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Admit for 6-hourly blood pressure monitoring and 24-hour urine protein
Discharge back to her family physician with advice for daily blood pressure and urine protein
