r: BP ≥ 160/110 ← Admit + treat. أقل من ذلك ← مراقبة.

q: A 40-year-old G4 P30Q3 at 32 weeks' gestation presented to the hospital with right upper quadrant pain. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her pain?
r: RUQ pain بالحمل المتأخر ← Hepatic capsule distension (HELLP/preeclampsia). Hepatic rupture نادر ويصاحبه shock.

q: A 25-year-old G2 POO1O at 33 weeks' gestation referred to the hospital with a BP of 160/110 mmHg on a routine appointment. Her BP at her first booking visit at 8 weeks was 124/70 mmHg with trace proteinuria. Further detailed history revealed that she was also complaining of headaches with no history of migraines. She was started on antihypertensives and magnesium sulfate along with steroid injections (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Bed rest to term and spontaneous labor
Bed rest to 37 weeks' gestation and induction of labor
Immediate induction of labor for anticipated vaginal delivery
r: Severe preeclampsia (بعد stabilization + steroids) ← Delivery. المفتاح: Induction of labor.
kw: magnesium sulfate along with steroid injections

q: A 26-year-old woman presented to the clinic pregnant at 15 weeks. She is known to have epilepsy and is taking Phenytoin. The last convulsion was 6 years ago. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Refer to Neurology to stop the medication
r: الحمل + epilepsy مستقرة ← كمّلي نفس الدواء (لا تتغيرين بعد الحمل). Valproate ← بدّليه قبل الحمل.

q: A 28-year-old primigravida came to the clinic at 38 weeks for a regular check-up. Her blood pressure was 170/110 mmHg. A urine dipstick showed +3 protein. Her blood work was taken, and she was sent to the labor and delivery room. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: Severe preeclampsia ← Magnesium sulfate (وقاية seizures) + antihypertensive + delivery.

q: A 22-year-old G2 P1 A0 L1 at 33 weeks of gestation with severe preeclampsia. Which of the following is the most appropriate drug of choice to prevent eclampsia?
r: الـdrug of choice لـeclampsia ← Magnesium sulfate (مو diazepam ولا phenytoin).

q: A 25-year-old woman in her first pregnancy presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. Examination shows her cervix is 2 cm dilated, 75% effaced, and she is contracting every 2 minutes. The fetal heart tracing is in the 140s and reactive (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient that everything is within normal
r: أعراض severe preeclampsia + labor ← Magnesium sulfate.
kw: headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain

q: A 35-year-old woman presented to the clinic for preconception counseling. She is known to have hypertension and is on ACE inhibitors. Which of the following is the most appropriate for her antihypertensive medication when she gets pregnant?
o: Continue on ACE inhibitors as it is safe
Continue because the benefit outweighs the risk
Cannot be stopped, so she should not get pregnant
Switch to alternative antihypertensive due to fetal kidney teratogenicity
r: ACEi/ARB ← بدّليها قبل الحمل بـmethyldopa/labetalol/nifedipine.

q: A 32-year-old woman G2 P1 L1. She is 39 weeks pregnant with normal prenatal care, presented to the Emergency Room with headache and blurred vision (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Admit for observation and repeat testing
r: أعراض preeclampsia severe بـ٣٩ أسبوع ← Delivery. قبل ٣٤ أسبوع ← stabilize + steroids.

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, post-date with dates confirmed by early scan, followed up weekly with normal CTG and amniotic fluid index. Her doctor planned for induction of labor. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication?
r: Induction ← Prostaglandin E2 لو cervix غير ناضج. Oxytocin لو ناضج.
kw: post-date with dates confirmed by early scan
normal CTG and amniotic fluid index

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. There was no leaking or bleeding. CTG showed normal heart rate and no contraction (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Headache + blurred vision + ألم بطن ← Preeclampsia (severe features). Seizure ← Eclampsia.
kw: headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. After assessment, CTG showed a normal heart rate with no contractions (see lab result). Which of the following is the most likely risk factor for preeclampsia?
r: Preeclampsia risk: Multiple gestation، primigravida، DM، HTN مزمن، obesity، age.
kw: headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain

q: A 25-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. After assessment, she started to have a grand mal seizure (see lab result). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Preeclampsia + seizure ← Eclampsia. Epilepsy معروفة قبل الحمل ← ليست.
kw: headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, pregnant with twins, presented to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks with headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain. After assessment, she started to have a grand mal seizure (see lab result). Which of the following is the most appropriate management plan?
r: Eclampsia ← Magnesium + stabilize ثم Delivery (مو antiepileptic عادي).
kw: headache, blurred vision, and abdominal pain

q: A 25-year-old woman G1 P0 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with vaginal leaking. Detailed history and physical examination confirmed preterm premature rupture of membranes. Her CTG showed a normal heart rate with no contractions. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: PPROM ← Erythromycin + ampicillin (latency) + dexamethasone. Tocolysis ما يفيد.

q: A 27-year-old woman, primigravida at 31 weeks of gestation, presented to the Emergency Department with tonic-clonic convulsions for the first time. Examination revealed she is unconscious, with a soft abdomen, fundal height corresponding to gestational age, and a positive fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate first step in the management?
r: Eclampsia ← ABC أول (Airway) ثم Magnesium sulfate ثم antihypertensive.
kw: tonic-clonic convulsions for the first time

q: A 39-year-old woman, a known case of chronic hypertension, presented at 37 weeks of gestation to the antenatal clinic for follow-up. Examination revealed that the uterine fundal height lags more than 3 cm behind the gestational age. What is the single most effective parameter for predicting fetal weight?
r: أفضل parameter لـfetal weight ← Abdominal circumference.
kw: uterine fundal height lags more than 3 cm behind the gestational age

q: A 27-year-old woman is seen during the active stage of labor at 39 weeks of gestation. CTG shows late decelerations of the fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate action to take?
r: Late decel ← Change maternal position (left lateral) + O2 + IV fluids + stop oxytocin.
kw: late decelerations of the fetal heart

q: A 35-year-old woman known case of chronic hypertension presented at 22 weeks of gestation with a blood pressure of 140/90 mmHg. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: HTN مزمن بالحمل ← Methyldopa (أو labetalol/nifedipine). ACEi/ARB ممنوعة.

q: A 33-year-old woman presented in preterm labor at 27 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is 6 cm dilated. Which of the following is the most appropriate drug to be given?
r: cervix 6 سم ← Steroids (tocolysis ما يفيد في cervix متقدم). Magnesium للـneuroprotection قبل ٣٢.
kw: preterm labor at 27 weeks of gestation

q: A 23-year-old primigravida presented at 29 weeks of gestation with eclamptic seizures. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Eclampsia ← Magnesium sulfate (مو phenytoin).

q: A 26-year-old primigravida presented at 34 weeks of gestation with eclamptic seizures. The seizures were controlled, and her blood pressure was brought down by antihypertensive medications. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Eclampsia بعد stabilization ← Delivery (مهما كان العمر).

q: A 27-year-old woman presented at 32 weeks of gestation with preterm labor. Her membrane was ruptured 12 hours ago, and she has been on antibiotics. She received the first dose of steroids. Which of the following is the most appropriate drug to be given?
r: تحت ٣٢ أسبوع ← Magnesium sulfate للـneuroprotection. Tocolytics ممنوعة مع chorioamnionitis.

q: A 20-year-old primigravida presented to the Emergency Department at 30 weeks of gestation, complaining of headache and blurred vision. Which of the following is the most appropriate antihypertensive medication?
r: Severe HTN بالحمل ← Labetalol (أو hydralazine/nifedipine). Nitroprusside آخر خيار.

q: A 23-year-old primigravida presented at 31 weeks of gestation with preterm labor. Examination revealed, the uterus is contracting and the cervix is closed. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Preterm labor قبل ٣٢ أسبوع ← Magnesium sulfate (neuroprotection). Tocolytic لتأخير ٤٨ ساعة.

q: A 20-year-old primigravida presented at 31 weeks of gestation with a headache and blurred vision. Urine examination by dipstick shows ++ proteinuria. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: HTN + proteinuria + أعراض ← Preeclampsia.

q: A 39-year-old woman presented at 14 weeks of gestation to the antenatal clinic for booking. She is a known case of hypertension and diabetes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: HTN + DM بالحمل ← Review medication أول (ACEi/ARB/statins/ oral hypoglycemics).
kw: known case of hypertension and diabetes

q: A 27-year-old woman presented at full term at labor, she was having uncontrolled diabetes during this pregnancy. Which of the following neonatal complications will most likely increase?
r: Infant of diabetic mother ← RDS، hypoglycemia، macrosomia، polycythemia. Hyperglycemia مو complication.

q: A 28-year-old Primigravida presented to the Antenatal Clinic for an Ultrasound scan. Ultrasound: Single viable fetus with significant lower levels of amniotic fluid (oligohydramnios). Which of the following is the most likely cause?
r: Oligo ← Placental insufficiency/PROM/renal agenesis. Polyhydramnios ← Diabetes/anencephaly/duodenal atresia.
kw: significant lower levels of amniotic fluid

q: A 22-year-old PG at 33 weeks of gestation newly diagnosed with gestational diabetes. Which of the following is the most appropriate first-line therapy?
r: Diet أول. لو فشل ← Insulin (أو metformin).

q: A 21-year-old G2 Pl AO Ll at 18 weeks of gestation presented to the obstetric clinic for the first time. The obstetrician asked for an oral glucose tolerance test. Which of the following is the most likely indication for this early request?
o: History of gestational diabetes in the previous pregnancy
r: History of GDM ← OGTT مبكر. BMI عالي أو DM بالعيلة برضو. BMI 20 ما يستدعي.

q: A 20-year-old woman in her first pregnancy came to the clinic at 32 weeks for a regular antenatal visit. She has gestational diabetes on insulin and is non-compliant with her medication. Her anatomy scan at 20 weeks was normal, and her fundal height is 38 cm. What is the most likely explanation for this difference between fundal height and gestational age?
r: GDM غير مسيطر + fundal > dates ← Polyhydramnios. لو twin ← كان بالـscan.
kw: gestational diabetes on insulin and is non-compliant
anatomy scan at 20 weeks was normal

q: A 35-year-old primigravida is seen in the Antenatal clinic for follow-up. She is currently smoking 12-15 cigarettes/day. She also gave a history of subfertility and a family history of diabetes in a second degree relative. Which of the following is the most significant risk factor?
r: أقوى risk factor مُعدّل ← Smoking (IUGR، abruption، preterm).
kw: family history of diabetes in a second degree relative

q: A 35-year-old woman, G3P2 diabetic patient at 38 weeks of gestation, is planned to have induction of labor. She has no abdominal or pelvic pain, and no vaginal loss. Examination revealed the uterine size corresponds to gestational age, soft, and not tender. Pelvic examination shows the cervix is closed and uneffaced. CTG is done. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: بدون أعراض + CTG ← Reassuring pattern.
kw: Pelvic examination shows the cervix is closed and uneffaced

q: A 22-year-old G2 PO Al at 13 weeks of gestation presented to the Antenatal Clinic. In her first pregnancy, she had a painless fetal passage at 22 weeks. Which of the following interventions is most recommended for the current pregnancy?
o: Regular antenatal visits with no specific intervention
r: Cervical insufficiency ← Cerclage (١٢–١٤ أسبوع). لو short cervix بدون history ← Progesterone.

q: A 23-year-old G2 P1 at 40 weeks of gestation presented to the Emergency Room complaining of painful uterine contractions. Vaginal examination revealed cervical dilatation of 3 cm and 60% effacement. Upon admission to the Labor Room, she had a gush of clear fluid. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: SROM = يتمزق أثناء labor. PROM = قبل labor ≥ ٣٧. PPROM = قبل ٣٧.

q: A 22-year-old PG at 30 weeks of gestation presented to the Emergency Room complaining of lower abdominal pain. Vaginal examination revealed cervical dilatation of 2 cm with 50% effacement. She was admitted to the Labor and Delivery Room. The consultant on duty decided to start her on oxytocin antagonist (atosiban) as a tocolytic. Which of the following is the rationale for using tocolytic therapy in this case?
o: Prevent preterm premature rupture of membranes
Delay labor to gain the maximum benefit from steroids
r: Tocolysis ← تأخير ٤٨ ساعة لإكمال steroids (ونقل المريضة). مو لمدّ الحمل لـ٣٧.

q: A 38-year-old primigravida at 33 weeks' gestation is diagnosed with small for gestational age fetus and reversed end-diastolic flow on umbilical artery Doppler. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Antenatal steroids and delivery within 1 week
Repeat ultrasound growth assessment in 2 weeks
r: Absent EDF ← Deliver حوالي ٣٤ أسبوع. Reversed EDF ← Steroids ثم Delivery.
kw: reversed end-diastolic flow on umbilical artery Doppler

q: A 25-year-old primigravida at 35 weeks' gestation presents with spontaneous rupture of membranes and undergoes augmentation of labor with parenteral oxytocin. Fetal monitoring shows distress. Which of the following maneuvers will most likely improve fetal oxygenation?
o: Ceasing the oxytocin to improve placental perfusion
Placing epidural analgesia to improve utero-placental perfusion
Initiating morphine sulfate to improve pain and hence placental perfusion
r: Fetal distress + oxytocin ← أوقفي oxytocin. وغيري position (left lateral)، O2، IV fluids.
kw: augmentation of labor with parenteral oxytocin

q: A 25-year-old G1 P0 woman presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with abdominal pain. There was no leaking or bleeding. The CTG shows a normal heart rate with regular contractions 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate way to diagnose if she has preterm labor?
o: History only is enough to diagnose
CTG showing regular contractions is diagnostic
If there is no leaking, then she isn’t in preterm labor
r: تشخيص preterm labor ← contractions + تغيّر cervix بالفحص (digital/ cervical length).
kw: diagnose if she has preterm labor

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 presented 3 days ago to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with preterm premature rupture of membranes. She was managed conservatively, and today she started to have fever and abdominal pain. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Ampicillin, Gentamicin, and deliver the patient
Check the source of fever and treat accordingly
r: PPROM + fever ← Chorioamnionitis ← Antibiotics + Delivery (لا انتظار).

q: A 26-year-old G4 P3 presented at 31 weeks gestation with labor pain. She had preterm premature rupture of membranes 4 weeks ago. Today, the cervix is 3 cm dilated with clear liquor noted. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: High vaginal swab for bacterial culture and sensitivity
r: PPROM قديم + labor ← ابدئي بـ High vaginal swab (cultures) مع antibiotics، وclear liquor ما يدل على infection.

q: A 27-year-old woman presented at 39 weeks of gestation with a history of spontaneous rupture of membranes 24 hours ago. Examination revealed a soft abdomen, cephalic presentation, and no uterine contractions. CTG shows normal fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: PROM بـterm + مرت ٢٤ ساعة ← Induction of labor (يقلل infection).
kw: spontaneous rupture of membranes 24 hours ago

q: A 29-year-old woman at 29 weeks of gestation presented with preterm labor. Which of the following tocolytics can cause patent ductus arteriosus?
r: Indomethacin (NSAID) ← يقفل PDA مبكرًا ويقلل السائل.

q: A 32-year-old woman presented with preterm labor at 34 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed, Symphysis fundal height corresponds to 34 weeks, vertex presentation. Vaginal assessment revealed that the cervix is 6 cm dilated. CTG confirms normal fetal heart. Which of the following is the most appropriate mode of delivery?
r: Preterm + vertex + labor متقدم + CTG طبيعي ← Vaginal delivery.

q: A 30-year-old G5P4 woman presents in labor at 34 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix was found to be 4 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station with intact membranes. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 110 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability with variable decelerations. The uterine contractions are strong and regular, occurring at a rate of 4 in 10 minutes. What would be the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Labor قائم + contractions قوية + CTG طبيعي ← ARM (تسرّع labor). Tocolytics لا.

q: A 33-year-old pregnant woman in her third trimester is evaluated in the clinic for her routine checkup visit. She is asymptomatic and denies a history of fever, dysuria, or urgency. Her examination is unremarkable (see lab results and report). Urine culture: Positive for Escherichia coli susceptible to different broad-spectrum antibiotics. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
r: Asymptomatic bacteriuria في الحامل ← عالجي. غير الحامل ← لا علاج.
kw: Urine culture: Positive for Escherichia coli

q: A 29-year-old woman, G2, Pl, at 38 weeks of gestation comes to the Labor and Delivery Ward with frequent painful contractions. Her prenatal course was significant for a urine culture that showed 100,000 colony-forming units/milliliter of Group-B streptococci and bronchial asthma, for which she uses a Ventolin inhaler. Which of the following medications should this patient be treated with during labor and delivery?
r: GBS (حتى bacteriuria) ← IV Penicillin/Ampicillin وقت الولادة.

q: A 30-year-old G4 P3 at 30 weeks of gestation presents with severe pain in the right flank radiating to her groin. She also complains of rigors and chills. Urine analysis: Numerous pus cells. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Pyelonephritis بالحمل ← Admit + IV antibiotics.
kw: right flank radiating to her groin

q: A 36-year-old woman (G4 P2103) at 23 weeks' gestation presents with a primary attack of herpes simplex virus infection. Acyclovir is given orally for 10 days. Which of the following is the rationale for acyclovir treatment?
o: Decrease the herpes simplex virus infection
Decrease viral shedding and current infection duration
r: Acyclovir يقلل الأعراض وviral shedding. بعد ٣٦ أسبوع ← suppression. Active lesions بالولادة ← C-section.
kw: primary attack of herpes simplex virus infection
Acyclovir is given orally for 10 days

q: A 33-year-old pregnant woman at 36 weeks of gestation presented with vaginal itching, burning, and irritation. Examination revealed a thick discharge with the appearance of cottage cheese in the vagina. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Candida بالحمل ← Topical antifungal (مو oral).

q: A 23-year-old woman found to be hepatitis B surface antigen positive at 14 weeks of gestation. Which of the following is the recommendation for the infant after birth?
o: Both hepatitis B vaccination and immunoglobulin
r: HBsAg+ ← الوليد يأخذ Vaccine + HBIG معًا خلال ١٢ ساعة.
kw: recommendation for the infant after birth

q: A primipara presents 1 week after delivery. She is tearful, has spells of crying, and lacks appetite and sleep. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: لو أقل من ١٠ أيام وخفيف ← Postpartum blues. لو hallucinations ← Postpartum psychosis.

q: A 30-year-old woman delivered her first baby 3 weeks ago and presented to the Emergency Room with fever, chills, and breast pain. Examination revealed the right breast is red, enlarged, and tender, with no fluctuation found (see lab result). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Reassure her and send her home
Stop breastfeeding and her symptoms will improve
Warm compressors and tight-fitting bra with enough analgesia
Antibiotics to cover Staphylococcus aureus and do breast ultrasound to rule out abscess
r: Mastitis ← Antibiotics (S. aureus) + استمرار الرضاعة. لو fluctuation ← abscess ← drainage.
kw: right breast is red, enlarged, and tender
delivered her first baby 3 weeks ago

q: A 28-year-old woman 2 weeks postpartum came to the clinic asking for contraception. She is exclusively breastfeeding. Which of the following is the most appropriate contraceptive method for her?
r: المفتاح هنا: Combined pills؟ (عادة لا قبل ٦ أسابيع). الخيارات الآمنة: progestin-only / IUD.

q: A 27-year-old woman delivered 2 weeks ago and presented with a painful, hard mass in the right breast. She received a 4-day course of antibiotics with no improvement. Examination revealed she is febrile, and a breast abscess is suspected. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Mastitis لا يتحسن ← Breast ultrasound + surgical review (drainage). وكمّلي الرضاعة.
kw: 4-day course of antibiotics with no improvement
painful, hard mass in the right breast

q: A 29-year-old woman in the second trimester of pregnancy presents to the Emergency Room due to progressive dyspnea for the past 24 hours. Examination reveals clear lungs and a swollen right lower limb (see lab results and report). Chest radiography: Normal. Which of the following is the most important initial diagnostic procedure?
r: لو ما فيه أعراض بالساق ← V/Q أو CTPA. مع أعراض الساق ← Doppler أول.

q: A 30-year-old woman is evaluated for new-onset nonproductive cough and dyspnea on exertion. She is pregnant at 30 weeks gestation. Medical history is unremarkable. Her only medication is a prenatal vitamin. Cardiopulmonary examination is normal. She has a gravid uterus and 2+ edema of the lower extremities without calf tenderness. Doppler ultrasonography of both legs is negative for deep venous thrombosis (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate diagnostic test to perform next?
r: لو CXR طبيعي ← V/Q أحسن (radiation أقل للثدي). لو CXR abnormal ← CTPA.
kw: Doppler ultrasonography of both legs is negative
new-onset nonproductive cough and dyspnea on exertion

q: A 30-year-old Primigravida at 17 weeks of gestation is known to have epilepsy and is on valproic acid. She was concerned about the possible risks to her baby. Which of the following fetal abnormalities is markedly increased?
r: Valproate ← Neural tube defect. Phenytoin ← Fetal hydantoin syndrome.

q: A 36-year-old presented to the Antenatal Clinic for an Ultrasound scan. Ultrasound: Single viable fetus with significant increased levels of amniotic fluid (polyhydramnios). Which of the following is the most likely cause?
r: Poly ← Anencephaly. Oligo ← Posterior urethral valve/renal agenesis.
kw: significant increased levels of amniotic fluid

q: A 23-year-old pregnant woman at 28 weeks of gestation. Ultrasound showed fetal hydrops with high peak systolic velocity more than 1.8 MOM in the middle cerebral artery Doppler. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
r: MCA PSV أكثر من ١٫٥ MoM ← Fetal anemia. Anti-Kell ← Anemia + hydrops.
kw: peak systolic velocity more than 1.8 MOM

q: A 30-year-old G2 Pl AO Ll at 33 weeks of gestation presented with decreased fetal movement. Obstetric ultrasound was performed. Which of the following is the most reassuring biophysical profile score (BPS)?
r: BPS 8–10 ← مطمئن. ٦ ← Equivocal. ٤ أو أقل ← Delivery.

q: A 28-year-old G2 P1 AO at 33 weeks of twin gestation presented to the Antenatal Clinic. Her investigations confirmed iron deficiency anemia. Which of the following is an indication for intravenous iron therapy?
r: IV iron: فشل/عدم تحمل oral أو anemia شديدة أو قرب الولادة.

q: A 19-year-old G1 P0 at 42 weeks is admitted for induction of labor. Her antenatal care was uncomplicated. Examination revealed the cervix was closed and long. Prostaglandin E2 is placed vaginally. An hour later, she started to contract regularly, and the fetal heart dropped to 70 bpm and was not recovering. Her vaginal examination showed a fully dilated cervix and presenting part at +2. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Start pushing and consider applying ventouse
r: Fetal bradycardia + fully dilated + station +2 ← Assisted vaginal delivery (ventouse). C-section لو مو ممكن.
kw: fully dilated cervix and presenting part at +2

q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy had an ultrasound confirming Monochorionic Diamniotic twins. What was the time interval between ovulation and cleavage?
r: Dichorionic diamniotic ← ٠–٣ أيام. Monochorionic diamniotic ← ٤–٨ أيام. Monoamniotic ← ٨–١٢. Conjoined ← > ١٢.
kw: time interval between ovulation and cleavage

q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy had an ultrasound confirming Monochorionic Monoamniotic twins. What was the time interval between ovulation and cleavage?
r: Monoamniotic ← ٩–١٢ يوم. Monochorionic diamniotic ← ٤–٨. Dichorionic ← ٠–٣ أيام (٧٢ ساعة).
kw: time interval between ovulation and cleavage

q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy had an ultrasound confirming Dichorionic Diamniotic twins. What was the time interval between ovulation and cleavage?
r: Dichorionic ← ٠–٣ أيام (قبل الـblastocyst). كل ما تأخر الانقسام قلّت الأغشية.
kw: time interval between ovulation and cleavage

q: A 30-year-old woman G2 P1 L1, 41 weeks pregnant confirmed dating with an early scan, started to follow up weekly with CTG twice a week. Her CTG showed deceleration with no signs of labor. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: ٤١ أسبوع + CTG abnormal ← Delivery. لو CTG طبيعي ← مراقبة/induction مجدولة.
kw: confirmed dating with an early scan

q: A 19-year-old G1 P0 at 41 weeks and 4 days was admitted for induction of labor. Her antenatal care was uncomplicated. Examination revealed her cervix was closed and long. Prostaglandin E2 was placed vaginally. An hour later, she started to contract regularly, and the fetal heart dropped to 70 beats per minute and was not recovering with fluid and oxygen administration. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Bradycardia بعد PGE2 + cervix مقفل ← C-section. لو fully dilated وstation +2 ← Ventouse.
kw: fetal heart dropped to 70 beats per minute
not recovering with fluid and oxygen

q: A 25-year-old woman G1 P0 presented to the Emergency Room at 30 weeks gestation with vaginal leaking. After taking detailed history, she mentioned that it was a large amount of fluid and it is still ongoing. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassure the patient and discharge home
Perform an ultrasound to check fetal weight and amniotic fluid
r: شك PROM ← Sterile speculum exam (لا digital). Digital يزيد infection.
kw: large amount of fluid and it is still ongoing

q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 was admitted at 41 weeks gestation in active labor. She had received pethidine and promethazine earlier. The cervix is 9 cm dilated, and meconium-stained liquor is draining. Non-stress test done shows no abnormalities. Which of the following is the most appropriate next action?
o: Change the position of the patient
r: Meconium + CTG طبيعي ← مراقبة، غيري position. Naloxone لو depression تنفس بالوليد.
kw: non-stress test done shows no abnormalities

q: A 32-year-old woman with twin pregnancy, presented at 38 weeks of gestation in active labor. Examination revealed twin A is in vertex presentation, and twin B is also in vertex presentation. Both fetal heart rates are normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Twin A vertex + twin B vertex ← Vaginal delivery. لو twin A non-vertex ← Cesarean.
kw: twin A is in vertex presentation
twin B is also in vertex presentation

q: A 20-year-old primigravida is seen in the Antenatal Clinic for follow-up. Clinical examination of uterine fundal height on 2 occasions revealed that there is an element of intrauterine growth restriction. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
r: شك IUGR ← Serial ultrasound (growth + Doppler).

q: A 33-year-old woman, known case of intrauterine growth restriction, presented at 38 weeks of gestation to labor and delivery. Examination revealed the fetus is in vertex presentation, cervix is 4 cm dilated with a reactive fetal heart on CTG. Which of the following is the most appropriate mode of delivery?
r: IUGR + vertex + CTG reactive ← Vaginal delivery. لو CTG abnormal/Doppler سيئ ← Cesarean.

q: A 31-year-old woman at 42 weeks of gestation with firm dates presented to the Antenatal Clinic. Examination revealed that the fetal head is well fixed in the pelvis, and the cervix is favorable. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Post-term + dates مؤكدة + cervix ناضج ← Induction of labor.
kw: 42 weeks of gestation with firm dates
fetal head is well fixed in the pelvis

q: A 32-year-old woman presented with reduced fetal movements at 36 weeks of gestation. What is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Reduced fetal movements ← CTG أول (+ ultrasound لو شك).

q: A 22-year-old primigravida is admitted for induction of labor at 41 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is closed and long. Which of the following will promote cervical ripening?
r: Unfavorable cervix ← Prostaglandin E2.
kw: induction of labor at 41 weeks of gestation

q: A 23-year-old primigravida presents to the Emergency Room at 35 weeks of gestation complaining of decreased fetal movement for the last few hours. Examination revealed the cervix is 1 cm dilated and the head is at -2 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 160 beats per minute with good accelerations, good variability, and early decelerations. The uterine contractions are mild and regular. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Baseline 160 + decreased movement ← Observation + continuous CTG (لا تعيدينها).
kw: decreased fetal movement for the last few hours

q: A 27-year-old G4P3 woman is seen in labor at 39 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is 5 cm dilated with clear amniotic fluid draining. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 140 beats per minute, no accelerations, good variability, and no decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Reassurance and reassessment in 30 to 60 minutes
r: Active labor + CTG مقبول ← Reassurance وإعادة التقييم بعد ٣٠–٦٠ دقيقة.
kw: no accelerations, good variability, and no decelerations

q: A 32-year-old G2P1 woman at 41 weeks of gestation presents in labor. Examination revealed the cervix is 7 cm dilated with meconium stained amniotic fluid draining, and the head is at -2 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 100 beats per minute, with poor variability, no accelerations, and no decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Bradycardia + poor variability + meconium ← Emergency cesarean.

q: A 19-year-old primigravida is diagnosed with intrauterine growth restriction in the antenatal follow-up. She came in labor at 38 weeks of gestation, the cervix is found to be 4 cm dilated with meconium-stained amniotic fluid. The cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 130 beats per minute, with no accelerations, poor variability, and recurrent late decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: IUGR + late decel + poor variability + meconium ← Emergency cesarean.

q: A 32-year-old woman G3P2 at 41 weeks of gestation is seen in the outpatient clinic. Abdominal palpation revealed there are no uterine contractions. Pelvic examination revealed that the cervix is thick and not dilated. The cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 130 beats per minute, with accelerations, good variability, and no decelerations. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Post-term + CTG طبيعي ← Induction of labor (مو انتظار ٧ أيام).
kw: cervix is thick and not dilated

q: A 21-year-old healthy primigravida is at 40 weeks in active labor. Pelvic assessment reveals that the cervix is 7 cm dilated, draining clear amniotic fluid, and the head is at +1 station. She is contracting regularly, 3 contractions in every 10 minutes, and the CTG is showing decelerations. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Decel مع contractions + head compression ← Early decelerations (طبيعي).

q: A 24-year-old woman is admitted to the labor and delivery unit at 37 weeks of gestation in labor. She is pregnant with monochorionic monoamniotic twins, and the first twin is in breech presentation while the second is in cephalic presentation. Examination revealed the cervix is 4 cm dilated. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: External cephalic version followed by vaginal delivery
r: Monoamniotic + twin A non-vertex ← Cesarean.
kw: first twin is in breech presentation

q: During duty in the Labor and Delivery Room, the nurse called to evaluate the cardiotocography of PG 39 weeks in active labor. The nurse asked about the relationship between the cause and type of deceleration. Which of the following combinations is the most likely to occur?
o: Fetal head compression causes late deceleration
Fetal head compression causes variable deceleration
r: Early ← Head compression. Variable ← Cord compression. Late ← Uteroplacental insufficiency.

q: A 28-year-old G4 P3 AO at 40 weeks of gestation presented with irregular contractions. She was admitted to the Labor and Delivery Ward. After how many hours will the latent phase be considered prolonged?
r: المفتاح ٨ ساعات. Latent phase طويل: أكثر من ٢٠ ساعة (nullipara) أو ١٤ (multipara) في المراجع.

q: A 35-year-old G3 P2002 woman presents to the clinic near term. Ultrasound demonstrates that the fetal head is in the fundus, the fetal spine is parallel to the mother's spine, with extended knees and flexed hips. Both arms are flexed at the elbows. Which of the following is the most appropriate description of fetal presentation?
r: Hips flexed + knees extended = Frank breech. Complete breech ← hips + knees flexed.
kw: fetal head is in the fundus
fetal spine is parallel to the mother's spine

q: A 25-year-old woman was admitted at 36 weeks gestation in labor. Fetal monitoring trace shows late decelerations. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Hydrate, reposition, and review in 20 minutes
r: Late decel ← Intrauterine resuscitation: hydrate + reposition + O2 وقف oxytocin، ثم أعيدي التقييم.

q: A 37-year-old primigravida with uterine fibroid presented at 34 weeks of gestation with abdominal pain and fever. Examination revealed the cervix is closed, and no uterine contractions are felt. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Fibroid بالحمل + ألم/حمى (red degeneration) ← Observation + analgesia. لا surgery.

q: A 21-year-old primigravida at 40 weeks of gestation with breech presentation is planned for a cesarean section. During surgery, a right ovarian cyst measuring 5 cm is observed. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Cyst أثناء cesarean ← Cystectomy (بدون aspiration/rupture).

q: A 35-year-old patient, 16 days post-cesarean section, presents with a fever that is not responding to antipyretics and antibiotics. She had four previous cesareans, and during surgery, extensive adhesions were found. She is passing urine, flatus, and stool. Examination reveals abdominal tenderness (see report). Contrast CT scan confirms the diagnosis of a small bowel fistula. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Restrict intake to a soft diet
NPO and start pancreatic and gastric secretion inhibitors
r: Fistula + يمرر flatus/stool (بدون obstruction) ← NPO + secretion inhibitors (conservative).
kw: fever that is not responding to antipyretics and antibiotics

q: A 30-year-old G5P4 woman presents in labor at 39 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 7 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 120 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability and occasional variable decelerations. The uterine contractions are mild and irregular, occurring at a rate of 2 contractions in each 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Active labor + contractions ضعيفة + CTG طبيعي ← Augmentation (oxytocin).

q: A 30-year-old G5P4 woman presents in labor at 37 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 10 cm dilated and the vertex is at -3 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 90 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability with recurrent late decelerations present. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Late decel + bradycardia + station عالي ← Emergency cesarean (لا instrumental).

q: A 28-year-old primigravida presents in labor at 37 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 10 cm dilated and the head is at +3 station. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 120 beats per minute, accelerations were present, good variability, and a prolonged deceleration was noted for the last 7 minutes. The uterine contractions are regular and strong. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Prolonged decel + fully dilated + station +3 ← Instrumental delivery (سريع).
kw: prolonged deceleration was noted for the last 7 minutes

q: A 20-year-old G2P1 presents in labor at 38 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 4 cm dilated. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 140 beats per minute with a sinusoidal pattern observed in the last 40 minutes. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Sinusoidal pattern = خطر شديد (fetal anemia/hypoxia) ← Cesarean.

q: A 24-year-old primigravida at 39 weeks of gestation is in the latent phase of labor. Examination revealed the cervix is 2 cm dilated. Cardiotocography shows a baseline of 140 beats per minute, moderate variability, no decelerations, and no accelerations present. Uterine contractions are mild and irregular. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Latent phase + contractions ضعيفة + CTG طبيعي ← Augmentation (المفتاح).
kw: Uterine contractions are mild and irregular

q: A 40-year-old G8P7 woman presents in active labor at 40 weeks of gestation. Examination revealed the cervix was found to be 7 cm dilated. Cardiotocography shows a baseline of 120 beats per minute, no decelerations, and poor variability with recurrent variable decelerations. The uterine contractions are regular and strong, occurring at a rate of 4 in 10 minutes. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Poor variability + recurrent variable decel ← Emergency cesarean.

q: A 25-year-old G2P1 woman at 39 weeks of gestation presents in the active phase of labor. Cardiotocography shows fetal tachycardia with a baseline of 180 beats per minute, with accelerations, early deceleration, and good variability. Which of the following has the highest alarming sign?
r: الأخطر من النتائج ← Fetal tachycardia (استبعدي infection/hypoxia). Early decel طبيعي.
kw: fetal tachycardia with a baseline of 180 beats per minute
accelerations, early deceleration, and good variability

q: A 30-year-old G3P2 woman presents with mild abdominal pain at 34 weeks of gestation. Cardiotocography shows a baseline of 140 beats per minute, good variability, accelerations were present with no decelerations. The examination is unremarkable, and the cervix was found to be 1 cm dilated and uneffaced. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: CTG طبيعي + cervix غير متغير ← Reassurance (ليست labor).
kw: cervix was found to be 1 cm dilated and uneffaced

q: A 23-year-old primigravida presents with mild, infrequent abdominal pains at 36 weeks of gestation. Cardiotocography shows that the baseline is 140 beats per minute with good accelerations and variability and no decelerations. The uterine contractions are irregular and mild. The examination is unremarkable with no cervical dilation. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: False labor ← Reassurance.

q: A 28-year-old woman G3P2 at 38 weeks of gestation is in active labor. Examination revealed the cervix is found to be 6 cm dilated. The cardiotocography is showing that the baseline is 120 beats per minute, absent accelerations and variability with recurrent late decelerations. Uterine contractions are strong, occurring at a rate of 3 to 4 every minute. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Absent variability + recurrent late decel ← Emergency cesarean.

q: A 23-year-old patient at 38 weeks of gestation is in active labor and diagnosed with cord prolapse. Which of the following is the most expected finding on CTG?
r: Cord prolapse ← Variable decelerations + bradycardia.

q: A 33-year-old G3P2 woman presents with mild uterine contractions for 12 hours. Examination revealed fundal height corresponds to gestational age, cephalic presentation, and mild contractions. Pelvic assessment shows the cervix is 4 cm dilated, and the head is at -1 station. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: Labor بطيء + contractions خفيفة ← Augmentation (oxytocin).
kw: fundal height corresponds to gestational age

q: A 25-year-old woman is seen for a routine prenatal evaluation; she is 12 weeks pregnant. This is her second pregnancy; the first pregnancy was uncomplicated. Medical history is notable for sickle cell disease requiring 1 to 2 hospitalizations per year for painful events. She has no history of stroke or acute chest syndrome. Her only medication is a folic acid supplement. Cardiac examination reveals a grade 2/6 systolic flow murmur (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
r: لو فيه stroke/acute chest/crises كثيرة ← Prophylactic transfusion. Hydroxyurea ممنوع بالحمل.
kw: sickle cell disease requiring 1 to 2 hospitalizations per year
no history of stroke or acute chest syndrome

q: A 35-year-old woman who had an uncomplicated vaginal delivery 2 weeks ago presented to the Emergency Room complaining of chest pain for 1 day, associated with exertional shortness of breath, no cough, no fever, no orthopnea, and no PND. Examination revealed an ill-looking woman (see reports). Pulmonary function test: FEV1 90% (80%-120%) FVC 95% (80%-120%) TLC 95% (80%-120%) DLCO 40% (60%-120%) Which of the following is the most likely cause of her shortness of breath?
r: DLCO واطي مع spirometry طبيعي ← PE أو ILD. FEV1 منخفض ← Obstructive.

q: A 32-year-old woman presents to the clinic with a 6-month history of mild fatigue. She does not have other symptoms. She is planning for pregnancy. Her physical examination is unremarkable. Her recent thyroid function is shown below. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
o: Proceed with pregnancy without any interventions
r: Overt hypothyroidism ← ابدئي thyroxine فورًا. Subclinical + حمل ← Thyroxine أثناء الحمل.

q: A 30-year-old Primigravida is found to have hyperthyroidism during her pregnancy. Which of the following is the most contraindicated?
r: Radioactive iodine ممنوع. Propylthiouracil بالثلث الأول، وmethimazole بعده.

q: A 32-year-old PG at 25 weeks of gestation is complaining of severe left calf pain and swelling. The area of concern is slightly edematous, but no erythema is apparent. Examination demonstrates a positive Homan's sign. Which of the following is the most appropriate primary mode of diagnosis?
r: DVT بالحمل ← Compression ultrasonography أول. D-dimer ما ينفع بالحمل.
kw: severe left calf pain and swelling

q: A 23-year-old PG at 28 weeks of gestation known case of tricuspid regurgitation complaining of slight limitation of physical activity. What is her heart failure class based on the New York Heart Association classification?
r: NYHA II: limitation بسيط. III: limitation واضح. IV: أعراض بالراحة.

q: A 32-year-old woman, primigravida, presented with shortness of breath during an antenatal visit. She was diagnosed with cardiac valve disease. Which of the following is associated with the worst outcome?
r: Mitral stenosis أسوأ بالحمل (pulmonary edema). Regurgitant lesions تتحمل أحسن.
kw: shortness of breath during an antenatal visit

q: A 24-year-old primigravida at her 11th week of pregnancy presents with a history of lethargy, constipation, and intolerance to cold temperature. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Hypothyroidism بالحمل ← Thyroxine فورًا. Hyperthyroid ← Propylthiouracil.
kw: lethargy, constipation, and intolerance to cold

q: A 25-year-old primigravida at 34 weeks' gestation presents with generalized pruritus and yellowish discoloration of the sclera and skin. Which of the following is the most important investigation?
o: Bile acids and liver function tests
r: Intrahepatic cholestasis ← Bile acids + LFT.
kw: yellowish discoloration of the sclera and skin

q: A 20-year-old primigravida at 8 weeks' gestation is known to have sickle cell disease, while her husband has normal hemoglobin. She has not taken any vitamin supplements so far. Which of the following is the most appropriate folic acid supplement to be prescribed?
r: Sickle cell disease ← Folic acid ٥ mg طوال الحمل. الاعتيادي ← ٤٠٠ mcg حتى ١٢ أسبوع.

q: A 24-year-old primigravida presents at 12 weeks gestation to an antenatal visit. Blood electrolytes and renal function tests were requested 3 days earlier. Which of the following is the most expected finding on her blood tests?
o: A fall in serum creatinine level
An increase of plasma sodium level
Increased plasma blood urea nitrogen level
Unaffected serum blood urea nitrogen level
r: الحمل ← creatinine وBUN ينزلون (GFR يرتفع ٥٠٪).
kw: Blood electrolytes and renal function tests

q: A 30-year-old woman in her first pregnancy. She is 20 weeks pregnant and known to have SLE. She has been symptom-free for the past 2 years. She is taking Plaquenil daily. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Refer to Rheumatology to stop the medication
r: Hydroxychloroquine آمن بالحمل ← كمّلي (يقلل flares).

q: A 39-year-old G4 P3 at 12 weeks of gestation came for an ultrasound study. Ultrasound: Single viable fetus with cystic hygroma. Which of the following is the most appropriate step in management to be offered at this gestational age?
r: عند ١٢ أسبوع ← CVS. بعد ١٥ أسبوع ← Amniocentesis.

q: A 25-year-old primigravida presents at 15 weeks of gestation to the antenatal visit where blood and urine investigations were requested. Which of the following is the most expected finding?
r: الحمل: Blood volume ↑ ٤٠–٥٠٪، وRBC mass ↑ ٢٠–٣٠٪ ← Hct ينزل (dilutional).

q: An 18-year-old G2 P1 presents for her first antenatal visit. The first day of her last menstrual period is May 7th. Her periods are regular, and she is sure about her periods. Which of the following is her estimated date of delivery?
r: قاعدة Naegele: LMP + ٧ أيام − ٣ شهور ≈ ١٤ فبراير. أقرب خيار بالأسئلة (Feb 10) هو المفتاح.
kw: first day of her last menstrual period is May 7th

q: A 35-year-old pregnant patient at 29 weeks gestation notices a bulge protruding from the vagina. She denies any pain, discomfort, or urinary or gastrointestinal symptoms. Examination reveals grade 2 posterior vaginal prolapse. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Prolapse بالحمل بدون أعراض ← Conservative + reassurance. لا urgent delivery.

q: A 25-year-old woman presents at 10 weeks of gestation for booking in the antenatal clinic. She gave a history of previous intrauterine death with multiple congenital anomalies. Which of the following is the most appropriate time for a detailed anomaly scan?
r: Detailed anomaly scan ← ١٨–٢٢ أسبوع. Nuchal ← ١١–١٤.
kw: previous intrauterine death with multiple congenital anomalies

q: A 33-year-old woman on oral contraceptive pills with strong androgenic progestin is seen in the clinic with a positive pregnancy test, where she is unaware of this pregnancy. Which of the following is the main teratogenic effect on the external genitalia of a female fetus?
r: Androgenic progestin ← Masculinization of female genitalia.
kw: oral contraceptive pills with strong androgenic progestin
teratogenic effect on the external genitalia of a female fetus

q: A 32-year-old nulligravid healthy woman presents for a routine visit. Physical examination is entirely normal. She is a heavy cigarette smoker. She undergoes colposcopy and cervical biopsies (see reports). Pap smear: High grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL). Cervical biopsies: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ (CIS). After counseling about her condition, she wants to preserve her fertility if her status allows. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: CIN3/CIS مع رغبة بالحمل ← Conization. لو ما تبي حمل ← Hysterectomy.

q: A 30-year-old woman G0P0 presented with a history of infertility for 3 years (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: المفتاح: hyperprolactinemia ← Bromocriptine (cabergoline). Clomid لو anovulation بدون prolactin.

q: A 31-year-old woman G2 P1 L1 had an uneventful pregnancy and went into spontaneous vaginal delivery. She delivered a healthy boy weighing 3000 g. After placental delivery, she started to bleed heavily. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial step in managing this patient?
o: Start blood transfusion with O negative blood
Send blood tests and manage accordingly
Take her to the operating room for surgical management
Call for help and make sure there is cross-matched blood
r: PPH: Call for help + cross-matched blood + ABC. لا تنقلين OR مباشرة قبل stabilize.
kw: most appropriate initial step in managing

q: A 23-year-old pregnant woman is seen at 9 weeks of gestation with moderate pelvic pain, which is dull in nature (see report). Ultrasound: Presence of an ovarian cyst of 4 cm in diameter. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Simple cyst بالحمل ← Observation (غالبًا corpus luteum). Torsion/rupture ← surgery.
kw: ovarian cyst of 4 cm in diameter
moderate pelvic pain, which is dull

q: A 36-year-old woman who is hypertensive on hydrochlorothiazide and losartan presents to the clinic because of the absence of her menstrual cycle for 2 months. She is asymptomatic. Her physical examination is unremarkable. A pregnancy test was done and was positive (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment adjustment?
r: ARB/ACEi ممنوعة بالحمل ← Methyldopa أو labetalol أو nifedipine.
kw: pregnancy test was done and was positive
absence of her menstrual cycle for 2 months

q: A 35-year-old woman diagnosed with left tubal ectopic pregnancy was treated with methotrexate. She remained asymptomatic with a plateauing of Beta hCG on day 4 and day 7. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
o: Repeat Beta hCG in one week
r: hCG لازم ينزل ١٥٪ بين يوم ٤ و٧. لو ما نزل ← Second dose methotrexate. لو ruptured ← surgery.
kw: plateauing of Beta hCG on day 4 and day 7

q: A 30-year-old woman presented with a history of the absence of her period for the last 3 months. Which of the following is the most appropriate test?
r: Amenorrhea ← Pregnancy test أول.
kw: absence of her period for the last 3 months

q: A 35-year-old woman is complaining of severe abdominal pain. She is a known case of primary infertility and underwent embryo transfer 3 weeks ago (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: بعد IVF/ART ← Ectopic (أعلى خطر). لو pain + فحص hCG موجب ← فكري heterotopic.

q: A 30-year-old woman presented with intermenstrual vaginal bleeding for 5 days. Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation?
r: أي نزيف بعمر إنجابي ← Beta hCG أول (استبعدي الحمل).

q: A 20-year-old woman came to the clinic for prenatal care. She missed her period for the last 6-8 weeks. Home pregnancy test was positive 2 weeks back and negative before that. Her periods were irregular and she is unsure of the last day of her menstrual period. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step for dating her pregnancy?
o: Wait 3-4 weeks then do an ultrasound
Counting from the positive urine pregnancy test
r: LMP غير معروف ← Ultrasound الآن (CRL).
kw: irregular and she is unsure of the last day
missed her period for the last 6-8 weeks

q: A 28-year-old woman presented with mild pelvic pain and spotting. She was diagnosed with an ectopic pregnancy and offered medical management. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication to treat this patient?
r: Ectopic stable ← Methotrexate. لو unstable/ruptured ← Surgery.

q: A 45-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room complaining that her period has not stopped for the past 15 days. Now she is feeling drowsy and easily fatigued and sometimes faints. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: AUB مع anemia/ضعف ← CBC + hCG أول (استبعدي حمل).
kw: period has not stopped for the past 15 days

q: A 26-year-old woman in her first pregnancy came to the clinic. Her last menstrual period is unknown. Which of the following is the most reliable way of dating her pregnancy?
r: أدق dating ← Crown-rump length (٧–١٣ أسبوع).

q: A 35-year-old woman underwent an uneventful suction evacuation procedure for a suspected hydatidiform mole. The human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level prior to the procedure was taken (see lab result and report). Histopathology: Confirmed the diagnosis of hydatidiform mole. Which of the following is the advised surveillance protocol by the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)?
o: Weekly beta-hCG until 3 negative readings are obtained
Monthly beta-hCG until negative, then weekly for 6 months
Weekly beta-hCG until negative, then monthly for 6 months
Monthly beta-hCG until 3 negative readings are obtained
r: بعد mole: hCG أسبوعيًا لين سلبي ثم شهريًا ٦ شهور. تجنبي الحمل خلال المتابعة.

q: A 35-year-old woman underwent suction curettage for a molar pregnancy, and her betahCG level was 70,000 mIU/mL prior to the procedure. She was followed up with weekly betahCG levels for 5 weeks: 1st week post-evacuation: 576 mIU/mL 2nd week post-evacuation: 350 mIU/mL 3rd week post-evacuation: 180 mIU/mL 4th week post-evacuation: 70 mIU/mL 5th week post-evacuation: 1 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: hCG لسه ما صار undetectable (١ ≠ ٠) ← Repeat weekly لين سلبي ثم monthly.

q: A 35-year-old woman presents with unusual vaginal bleeding and a fleshy vaginal mass. She underwent a suction evacuation for hydatidiform mole. Her beta-hCG level was 870,000 mIU/mL prior to the procedure. She was followed with weekly beta-hCG levels for 5 weeks, with the following results: 1st week: 576 mIU/mL 2nd week: 350 mIU/mL 3rd week: 180 mIU/mL 4th week: 70 mIU/mL 5th week: 300 mIU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Perform a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis
Perform a metastatic workup without biopsy
r: hCG ينزل ثم يرتفع (٧٠ ← ٣٠٠) + mass ← GTN ← Metastatic workup بدون biopsy (خطر نزيف).

q: A 35-year-old woman presents to the Emergency Room with sudden severe abdominal pain for the last three hours, sharp in nature and radiating to the right shoulder. She has an irregular menstrual cycle, and the last episode was six weeks ago. Examination reveals guarding and rigidity of the abdomen. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
r: امرأة بعمر إنجابي بألم حاد + amenorrhea ← Pregnancy test أول (تؤكد/تستبعد ectopic).
kw: guarding and rigidity of the abdomen

q: A 30-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room with sudden severe and sharp abdominal pain for the last three hours, radiating to the right shoulder. She has an irregular menstrual cycle, and the last episode was six weeks ago. Examination revealed a rigid abdomen with guarding of note (see report). Pelvic Ultrasound: Abundant fluid in the pouch of Douglas. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Ruptured ectopic مع unstable ← Laparotomy فورًا.
kw: Abundant fluid in the pouch of Douglas

q: A 22-year-old woman presents to the booking clinic after performing a home pregnancy test, which was positive. She is not sure of her dates, as she has irregular menses. Which of the following is the most appropriate test for dating her pregnancy?
r: أدق dating ← Crown-rump length (٧–١٣ أسبوع).

q: A 26-year-old woman was treated with methotrexate for an ectopic pregnancy. Her BhCG results are as follows: - Baseline test was 3000 miu/ml on the day of the injection - Day 4: BhCG was 3100 miu/ml - Day 7: BhCG was 2900 miu/ml Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Administer a multiple dose regimen of methotrexate
Counsel for the possibility of administering a second methotrexate dose
r: hCG ما نزل ١٥٪ يوم ٤–٧ ← Second dose (إن stable). ينزل ≥ ١٥٪ ← متابعة.
kw: 3000 miu/ml on the day of the injection

q: A 26-year-old woman was treated with methotrexate 8 days ago for ectopic pregnancy and presents to the Emergency Room with mild abdominal pain and vaginal spotting. Examination revealed a soft and non-tender abdomen. Her BhCG results show a drop from 1200 miu/ml on Day 4 to 500 miu/ml on Day 7. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: hCG نزل ≥ ١٥٪ + stable ← Reassure ومتابعة (ألم خفيف شائع).
kw: drop from 1200 miu/ml on Day 4 to 500 miu/ml on Day 7
mild abdominal pain and vaginal spotting

q: A 35-year-old smoker man and a 26-year-old woman presented with primary infertility for 3 years. The wife had 3 cycles of Clomid as a case of polycystic ovaries. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Hormonal profile day 2 of the cycle
r: Infertility ← Semen analysis أول (أسهل وأرخص) قبل فحوص الزوجة.

q: A 20-year-old woman presented with a history of primary infertility for 1 year. She had a history of scanty irregular cycles with prolonged intervals (see lab results). Which of the following is the important workup?
r: Primary oligomenorrhea صغيرة ← Chromosomal analysis (Turner mosaic). Prolactin/TSH روتينية.
kw: scanty irregular cycles with prolonged intervals

q: A 26-year-old woman, her menarche was at the age of 15 years. Her last cycle was 9 months ago (see lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Secondary amenorrhea + FSH عالي قبل ٤٠ ← Premature ovarian insufficiency. PCOS ← LH/FSH + hirsutism.
kw: menarche was at the age of 15 years

q: A 26-year-old woman with primary infertility is seen in the gynecology clinic for investigations. Her FSH, LH, and serum prolactin are normal. Pelvic Ultrasound is also reported as normal. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value for ovulation?
r: Ovulation ← Progesterone day 21 (mid-luteal).
kw: FSH, LH, and serum prolactin are normal

q: A 26-year-old woman presents with amenorrhea for the last 14 weeks. She started to have mild vaginal bleeding for the last 3 days. Examination revealed the uterine size is 18 weeks and is doughy on palpation. Ultrasound: An enlarged uterus with a snowstorm appearance. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Molar pregnancy ← Suction evacuation (مو medical).
kw: uterine size is 18 weeks and is doughy

q: A 25-year-old woman is seen in the infertility clinic as a case of primary infertility for 2 years. Her history revealed that she has had amenorrhea for the last 6 months and only gets menstruation through using withdrawal bleeding pills. She had investigations repeated twice, performed 3 months apart, and they were all showing the same results. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Premature ovarian insufficiency (FSH عالي) ← HRT. حمل يحتاج donor eggs.

q: A 24-year-old woman has been trying to get pregnant for the last 18 months. She was recently diagnosed with polycystic ovarian syndrome and has irregular menstrual cycles. Her husband's semen analysis was normal, and she has not received any medication. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
o: Oral contraceptives to regulate the menstrual cycle
r: PCOS + infertility ← Clomiphene (أول). Metformin/letrozole بدائل.
kw: trying to get pregnant for the last 18 months

q: A 45-year-old otherwise healthy woman presents to the clinic complaining of amenorrhea for the last 18 weeks. Her periods prior to this were all regular. Ultrasound: Presence of a snowstorm pattern within the uterine cavity. Which of the following is the most appropriate test to reach the diagnosis?
r: Snowstorm ← Molar pregnancy ← hCG (عالي جدًا).
kw: snowstorm pattern within the uterine cavity

q: A 22-year-old, otherwise healthy woman, presents to the Emergency Room complaining of amenorrhea for the last 8 weeks and expelling blood and tissue through the vagina. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
o: Pelvic examination and CT scan of the pelvis
r: Amenorrhea + tissue ← Pelvic examination + Ultrasound (يحدد نوع abortion).
kw: expelling blood and tissue through the vagina

q: A 20-year-old nulliparous healthy married woman presents to the clinic requesting contraception. She has a history of menorrhagia and occasional dysmenorrhea. No family history of note. Which of the following is the most appropriate contraception method?
r: COC يخفف menorrhagia وdysmenorrhea. لو smoker فوق ٣٥ أو migraine with aura ← Progestin-only.

q: A 42-year-old P3003 healthy woman presents with a history of heavy and prolonged vaginal bleeding over the past 7 months. Her periods have become longer and progressively heavier. Her LMP was 15 days ago. Pelvic examination reveals a small amount of blood in the vaginal vault, a normal-sized uterus, and mobile ovaries. Pelvic ultrasound: 2.5 cm x 1.5 cm lesion in the uterine cavity. Which of the following is the most likely cause of bleeding?
r: Intracavitary lesion صغيرة ← Endometrial polyp. Fibroid ← uterus كبير. Adenomyosis ← uterus globular.
kw: heavy and prolonged vaginal bleeding over the past 7 months

q: A 33-year-old single woman was found to have a uterine fibroid incidentally on pelvic ultrasound. Ultrasound: Subserosal uterine fibroid measuring 5x5 cm. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Asymptomatic fibroid ← Conservative. Surgery بس لو أعراض.

q: A 33-year-old woman presents with a complaint of a heavy menstrual cycle. During examination, a firm fundal mass was felt. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Menorrhagia + mass ← Pelvic ultrasound أول (MRI بعد لو قرار surgery).
kw: most appropriate next step in management

q: A 60-year-old menopausal woman presents with recent on-and-off vaginal bleeding. Which of the following is the most common cause of her complaint?
r: Postmenopausal bleeding أشيع سبب ← Atrophy. لكن لازم تستبعدين cancer (endometrial thickness).

q: A 43-year-old woman presented with intermenstrual bleeding in the last 3 months (see report). Ultrasound: A 13 mm long echogenic structure in the endometrium. Which of the following is the most appropriate management option?
o: Hysteroscopy and removal of the structure
r: Endometrial polyp ← Hysteroscopy + removal (تشخيص + علاج).
kw: 13 mm long echogenic structure in the endometrium

q: A 30-year-old woman presented with a history of recurrent urinary tract infections. She notices it happening after sexual intercourse. Which of the following is the most appropriate recommendation?
r: UTI بعد الجماع ← Postcoital single-dose antibiotic. Frequent ← prophylaxis daily.

q: A 23-year-old single woman presented with heavy menstruation during the first 4 days of her period for the last 2 years (see image and lab results). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Menorrhagia + uterus كبير ← Fibroids (leiomyomas). Polyp ← intermenstrual.
kw: heavy menstruation during the first 4 days

q: A 23-year-old single girl diagnosed with a 5*5 cm uterine leiomyoma incidentally during a kidney ultrasound. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: Asymptomatic fibroid ← Conservative. Surgery لو أعراض أو حمل مخطط.

q: A 35-year-old woman with a leiomyoma associated with heavy menstruation (see image and lab result). Which of the following is the most appropriate next management step?
r: Fibroid + heavy bleeding + anemia ← صححي الـanemia أول (iron) قبل الجراحة.

q: A 33-year-old woman, nulliparous, complaining of cyclic pelvic pain and dyschezia underwent diagnostic laparoscopy (see image). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Cyclic pain + dyschezia + laparoscopy ← Endometriosis.

q: A 45-year-old woman presented to the clinic complaining of postcoital bleeding. Pelvic examination revealed a 2*1 cm cervical mass. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
r: Cervical mass ← Punch biopsy (مو Pap). Pap للـscreening.

q: A 45-year-old woman presented to the Emergency Room complaining that her period has not stopped for the past 15 days and now she is feeling drowsy and easily fatigued (see lab results). Which of the following is the most appropriate next step?
o: Manage the bleeding and send her home
r: AUB + symptomatic anemia شديد (Hb منخفض جدًا) ← Blood transfusion.
kw: period has not stopped for the past 15 days

q: A 25-year-old woman presented with abnormal uterine bleeding, underwent an endometrial biopsy (see report). Endometrial biopsy: Atypical complex hyperplasia. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: عمر ٢٥ + atypical hyperplasia ← High-dose progesterone (تحافظ على fertility). بعد ٤٥ أو انتهاء الإنجاب ← Hysterectomy.

q: A 51-year-old woman P6+2 presents with pelvic pressure, heaviness in the lower abdomen, and heavy menstrual bleeding. Bimanual pelvic examination revealed a firm, irregular, enlarged uterus is felt (see report). Pelvic Ultrasound: A large submucous fibroid 7x8 cm in size. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Large fibroid + عمر ٥١ وانتهى الإنجاب ← Hysterectomy. لو تبي fertility ← Myomectomy.

q: A 42-year-old woman presented with pelvic pressure, bloating, and heaviness in the lower abdomen. Her cycle is prolonged with heavy menstrual bleeding (see report). Ultrasound: Presence of uterine fibroid. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Heavy bleeding + fibroid ← Submucosal (يسبب menorrhagia). Subserosal ← pressure.

q: A 42-year-old P4+2 presented with severe, progressive secondary dysmenorrhea and menorrhagia. Pelvic examination demonstrated a tender, diffusely enlarged uterus (see report). Endometrial biopsy: Normal endometrium. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: Parous + diffusely tender enlarged uterus ← Adenomyosis. Endometriosis ← nulliparous، uterus طبيعي.

q: A 38-year-old woman is scheduled to undergo a myomectomy due to the presence of a large uterine fibroid. The surgeon is planning to administer medication that will help reduce the size of the uterine fibroid prior to performing the procedure. Which of the following is the most appropriate medication to use for this purpose?
r: قبل myomectomy ← GnRH agonist (يصغر fibroid ويقلل blood loss).
kw: reduce the size of the uterine fibroid prior

q: A 38-year-old woman presents with pelvic pressure and menorrhagia. She was diagnosed to have a large uterine anterior wall fibroid of 10 cm in size. Ultrasound shows a distorted endometrial lining secondary to the fibroid. The patient was offered hysterectomy but she declined. Which of the following is the most appropriate alternative management?
r: بديل للـhysterectomy مع fibroid كبير + رغبة بالحفاظ ← Uterine artery embolization.
kw: large uterine anterior wall fibroid of 10 cm
The patient was offered hysterectomy but she declined

q: A 24-year-old woman presents to the clinic with an incidental finding of a uterine fibroid. Her menstrual cycle is regular, and her examination is unremarkable. Ultrasound: An anterior subserosal fibroid of 3 x 2 cm, otherwise the other areas of the uterus, ovaries, and adnexa are unremarkable. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Asymptomatic small fibroid ← Reassure ومتابعة.
kw: anterior subserosal fibroid of 3 x 2 cm
incidental finding of a uterine fibroid

q: A 32-year-old single woman is attending the clinic complaining of menorrhagia for the last few months. The physical examination is unremarkable. Pelvic Ultrasound: Presence of a serosal fibroid, 4 x 4 cm in size. Otherwise, the other parameters of the ultrasound were normal. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Serosal fibroid ما يسبب menorrhagia عادة ← NSAIDs (أو ابحثي عن سبب ثاني). Surgery لا.
kw: menorrhagia for the last few months

q: A 50-year-old woman presents with menorrhagia for the last year. The physical examination is unremarkable. A trial of medical treatment failed to control the bleeding for the last few months. Ultrasound: Presence of a fibroid, 7 x 7 cm in size, which is distorting the endometrial lining. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: فشل medical + fibroid كبير + عمر ٥٠ ← Hysterectomy.
kw: fibroid, 7 x 7 cm in size, which is distorting the endometrial lining

q: A 25-year-old woman has been seeking fertility for the last 3 years. She had 2 unsuccessful in vitro fertilization trials. Pelvic Ultrasound: Multiple uterine fibroids of variable sizes. Which of the following will most likely increase her chance of reaching a successful pregnancy?
o: GnRH injection to reduce the size of the fibroids
r: Fibroids + infertility + فشل IVF ← Myomectomy.
kw: seeking fertility for the last 3 years

q: A 60-year-old woman is attending the clinic complaining of post-menopausal bleeding for the last 3 months. She was found to have a uterine fibroid of 5 cm in size, noted in a recent ultrasound. Upon review of the previous medical records, the ultrasound performed 5 years ago showed the same size and location of the fibroid. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Postmenopausal bleeding حتى مع fibroid قديم ← Endometrial sample أول.
kw: ultrasound performed 5 years ago showed the same size

q: A 40-year-old woman presents with menorrhagia for the last 6 months. She underwent an endometrial biopsy. Endometrial biopsy: Presence of simple endometrial hyperplasia without atypia. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?
r: Hyperplasia بدون atypia ← Progesterone (IUD هرموني أو oral).

q: A 45-year-old woman presents with menorrhagia for the last 8 months. She is known to be diabetic and hypertensive. Ultrasound: Thickened endometrial lining of approximately 23 mm. Which of the following has the highest diagnostic value?
o: CT of the abdomen and pelvis
r: Endometrium سميك + AUB + DM/HTN ← Endometrial biopsy (استبعدي hyperplasia/cancer).
kw: Thickened endometrial lining of approximately 23 mm
known to be diabetic and hypertensive

q: A 34-year-old healthy woman presents with recurrent symptoms, including headache, anxiety, and mastalgia, that start 8-10 days before menstruation and improve afterward. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: PMS: قبل الدورة وتتحسن بعدها. لو الألم يستمر بعد الدورة ← Endometriosis.

q: A 53-year-old woman, whose last menstrual period was 18 months ago, is complaining of dyspareunia for the past few months. Which of the following is the most appropriate management?
r: Vaginal atrophy فقط ← Local estrogen cream. Systemic hot flashes ← Systemic estrogen.
kw: last menstrual period was 18 months ago

q: A 28-year-old woman presented with a history of secondary infertility for 4 years (see image). Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
r: صورة laparoscopy: endometriotic implants (chocolate/ powder-burn) ← Endometriosis.

q: A 30-year-old woman married for 3 years with a history of an irregular cycle. Her husband's seminal analysis was normal. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
r: Irregular cycle + semen طبيعي ← Ovulatory dysfunction (PCOS).

q: A 30-year-old woman diagnosed with endometriosis tried non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents but is still symptomatic. Which of the following is the most appropriate next management?
r: فشل NSAIDs ← هرمونات: COC أو progestin. المفتاح هنا Oral progesterone.
kw: tried non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents but is still symptomatic

q: A 45-year-old woman P6 is complaining of chronic pelvic pain and heavy menstruation (see report). Pelvic MRI: Diffuse thickened myometrium. Which of the following is the most definitive treatment for her condition?
r: Adenomyosis (parous + MRI thick myometrium) ← Hysterectomy (definitive).
kw: chronic pelvic pain and heavy menstruation

q: A 32-year-old woman presented to the Gynecology Clinic with dysmenorrhea. Which of the following is the most important history for evaluation?
r: Dysmenorrhea ← Menstrual history أهم (primary vs secondary).

q: A 32-year-old woman presents to the Infertility Clinic for investigations. She has been married for the last 3 years and is complaining of dysmenorrhea and deep dyspareunia. Abdominal and pelvic examination revealed no pathology. Which of the following is the most appropriate investigation for tubal patency?
r: شك endometriosis + فحص tubal patency ← Laparoscopy + dye (يشخص ويعالج). HSG لو بدون شك pelvic disease.

q: A 54-year-old menopausal woman presents with a history of involuntary urine leaks with urgency. The complaint occurs at any time during the day or night, without warning. There is no clear association between leaks and any specific activity, with occasional association with coughing and laughing. Physical examination is unremarkable. Urinalysis and culture are negative. Urodynamic study shows spontaneous bladder contractions even with small bladder filling. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
r: Urge incontinence (OAB) ← Anticholinergics. Stress ← Kegel/sling.
kw: Urodynamic study shows spontaneous bladder contractions

q: A 62-year-old postmenopausal woman (P4014), known diabetic and with congestive heart failure, is referred by a Cardiology Clinic. She has occasional incontinence with coughing and sneezing. During the interview, she also complains of lower abdominal heaviness and vaginal bulging. Pelvic examination reveals second-degree pelvic prolapse. Which of the following is the recommended treatment for this woman?
r: High surgical risk (DM + HF) ← Vaginal pessary.
kw: known diabetic and with congestive heart failure
occasional incontinence with coughing and sneezing

q: A 55-year-old woman presents with on-and-off vaginal bleeding. She is menopausal for 3 years and has been taking conjugated estrogen pills. There is no previous surgical history. Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?
o: Shift her to oral contraceptive pills
r: Estrogen بدون progesterone ← hyperplasia/cancer ← أضيفي Progesterone (uterus موجود).

q: A 50-year-old woman is complaining of hot flashes and insomnia. Which of the following is the most appropriate first-line management?

q: A patient has a hard breast mass . Which type of biopsy is most appropriate?

q: A child has a midline neck swelling that moves upward with swallowing and protrusion of the tongue . What is the most likely diagnosis?

r: A midline neck swelling in a child that moves up with swallowing and with tongue protrusion is a thyroglossal duct cyst. q: A patient is involved in a motor vehicle accident. While trying to avoid other vehicles, he swerves off the road and crashes into an object. Imaging reveals a widened mediastinum with pleural effusion . What is the most likely diagnosis?

q: Large open fracture , most appropriate management

x: A. Intramedullary fixation and wound closure: there is no debridement and primary closure of a large contaminated wound traps bacteria and risks deep infection and osteomyelitis; nailing is acceptable only after thorough debridement.

q: 38 y came to clinic with ulcer in medial aspect of leg Which most risk factors

q: A woman is brought to the Emergency Department after a traumatic injury. Examination and imaging reveal a posterior elbow dislocation with a (complex comminuted ) radial head fracture . What should be the next step in management?

q: A patient was admitted with right lower quadrant pain and diagnosed with ruptured appendicitis with a localized abscess . WBC is 13.6. What is the most appropriate initial management?

q: A female post-laparoscopic cholecystectomy 2 weeks ago presents to the emergency room complaining of vague abdominal pain. Labs show elevated total and direct bilirubin. CT abdomen reveals a 10 x 15 cm subhepatic collection found to be a biloma . What is the most appropriate management?

q: A 21-year-old man came with generalized abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting. He is a heavy smoker . On examination, the abdomen is scaphoid and rigid . Blood pressure is 110/70, heart rate is 105, temperature is 38.5, and oxygen saturation is 95%. What is the most appropriate initial test?

Abdominal ultrasound is first line for biliary disease, pediatric appendicitis or pregnancy, not for detecting pneumoperitoneum. | D. q: A patient presents with acute pancreatitis . Which of the following is most useful for assessing severity and prognosis ?

q: 24 year old complain of RLQ pain nausea and vomiting ( symptoms of appendicitis) examination show right iliac fossa mass CT SCAN. Shows periappendicular collection 10x12 of abscess with fecalith and it extends to right flank

q: 44 years male patient came with Painless hematuria only , on P\ E normal What to do next ?
